example.en: I'll text you the final score.
example.cn: 我会发短信告诉你最终的比分。

senses.def: a book that teaches a particular subject and that is used especially in schools and colleges

ex.en: a school/medical/history, etc. textbook
ex.cn: 学校、医学、历史等教科书

senses.def: used to describe sth that is done exactly as it should be done, in the best possible way

ex.en: a textbook example of how the game should be played
ex.cn: 这项比赛的标准示范

senses.def: a system or program that allows you to make changes to text
senses.chn: 文本编辑系统（或程序）；文字编辑器

senses.def: a person who sends text messages
senses.chn: 发送（手机）短信息的人；短信发送者

senses.def: any type of cloth made by weaving or knitting

ex.en: a factory producing a range of textiles
ex.cn: 生产一系列纺织品的工厂

ex.en: the textile industry
ex.cn: 纺织工业

ex.en: a textile designer
ex.cn: 纺织品设计师

ex.en: cotton fabric
ex.cn: 棉织物

ex.en: furnishing fabrics
ex.cn: 室内装饰织物

ex.en: His bandages had been made from strips of cloth.
ex.cn: 他的绷带是用布条做的。

senses.def: the industry that makes cloth
a written message that you send using a mobile/cell phone

ex.en: Send a text message to this number to vote.
ex.cn: 请发短信到此号码参加投票。

example.en: I text-messaged him to say we were waiting in the pub.
example.cn: 我发短信告诉他我们在酒吧里等候。

senses.def: the kind of language that is typically used in text messages, for example short forms of words, initials, symbols, etc.
senses.chn: 短信文，短信用语（尤用于手机短信的缩略词、首字母、符号等）

senses.def: a computer program that converts text into spoken language
senses.chn: 文本语音转换程序；语音朗读程序；文字至语音转换程序

ex.en: text-to-speech software
ex.cn: 文本语音转换软件

ex.en: a TTS package
ex.cn: 语音朗读软件包

senses.def: connected with or contained in a text

ex.en: textual analysis
ex.cn: 文本分析

ex.en: textual errors
ex.cn: 文本错误

senses.def: relating to texture

ex.en: the textural characteristics of the rocks
ex.cn: 岩石的纹理特征

senses.def: the way a surface, substance or piece of cloth feels when you touch it, for example how rough, smooth, hard or soft it is

ex.en: the soft texture of velvet
ex.cn: 天鹅绒柔软的质地

ex.en: She uses a variety of different colours and textures in her wall hangings.
ex.cn: 她悬挂的帷幔色彩和质地多姿多彩。

senses.def: the way food or drink tastes or feels in your mouth, for example whether it is rough, smooth, light, heavy, etc.

ex.en: The two cheeses were very different in both taste and texture.
ex.cn: 这两种奶酪的味道和口感大不相同。

senses.def: the way that different parts of a piece of music or literature are combined to create a final impression
senses.chn: （音乐或文学的）和谐统一感，神韵

ex.en: the rich texture of the symphony
ex.cn: 这首交响曲优美和谐的乐感

senses.def: with a surface that is not smooth, but has a particular texture

ex.en: textured wallpaper
ex.cn: 起纹理的壁纸

senses.def: a substance that looks like meat, but which is made from soya beans
senses.chn: 结构性植物蛋白，植物组织蛋白，素肉（用大豆制成）

senses.def: a piece of technology used to make flat screens for computers, mobile/cell phones, etc. (the abbreviation for thin film transistor)
senses.chn: 薄膜晶体管（全写为 thin film transistor，电脑、手机等的平面屏幕制造技术）

ex.en: a 17 in TFT screen
ex.cn: 17 英寸薄膜晶体管显示器

senses.def: transformational grammar
(a person) from Thailand
senses.chn: 泰国人；泰国的；泰国人的

senses.def: a country in South East Asia
a metal plate on which food is served
a set meal at a restaurant
a sedative drug which was used until the 1960s, when it was discovered that if given to pregnant women, it prevented some babies from developing normal arms and legs
senses.chn: 酞胺呱啶酮，反应停（一种镇定药，20 世纪 60 年代发现孕妇服用后会导致胎儿四肢畸形而被禁用）

senses.def: a chemical element. Thallium is a soft silver-white metal whose compounds are very poisonous.
used to introduce the second part of a comparison
senses.chn: （用以引出比较的第二部分）比

ex.en: I'm older than her.
ex.cn: 我比她年龄大。

ex.en: There was more whisky in it than soda.
ex.cn: 那里面的威士忌比苏打水多。

ex.en: He loves me more than you do.
ex.cn: 他比你更爱我。

ex.en: It was much better than I'd expected.
ex.cn: 这比我预料的要好得多。

ex.en: You should know better than to behave like that.
ex.cn: 你应当明白事理，不该那么不懂规矩。

ex.en: I'd rather email than phone, if that's OK by you.
ex.cn: 如果你认为可以的话，我想发电邮而不打电话。

senses.def: used for comparing amounts, numbers, distances, etc.
senses.chn: （比较数量、距离等）多于，小于，少于

ex.en: It never takes more than an hour.
ex.cn: 所用的时间从不会超过一个小时。

ex.en: It's less than a mile to the beach.
ex.cn: 离海滩不足一英里远。

ex.en: There were fewer than twenty people there.
ex.cn: 那里有不到二十个人。

senses.def: used in expressions showing that one thing happens straight after another
senses.chn: （表示一事紧跟另一事发生）就

ex.en: No sooner had I sat down than there was a loud knock on the door.
ex.cn: 我刚坐下就有人大声敲门。

ex.en: Hardly had we arrived than the problems started.
ex.cn: 我们刚到，问题就来了。

senses.def: except

ex.en: I don't know any French people other than you.
ex.cn: 除了你，我不认识别的法国人。

ex.en: We're going away in June but other than that I'll be here all summer.
ex.cn: 我们六月份外出；除此以外，我整个夏天都在这里。

senses.def: different or in a different way from; not

ex.en: I have never known him to behave other than selfishly.
ex.cn: 我从没见过他不自私。

senses.def: a way of saying or writing the word 'thing', that represents the pronunciation of the southern US
senses.chn: 东西，事物（用于说话或书写，表示美国南方对 thing 一词的发音）

senses.def: to tell sb that you are grateful for sth
senses.chn: 谢谢，感谢（某人）；（为某事）道谢

ex.en: I must write and thank Mary for the present.
ex.cn: 我得写信感谢玛丽送给我这份礼物。

ex.en: In his speech, he thanked everyone for all their hard work.
ex.cn: 他在讲话中感谢大家各尽其力。

ex.en: She said goodbye and thanked us for coming.
ex.cn: 她向我们道别，并感谢我们的光临。

ex.en: There's no need to thank me—I enjoyed doing it.
ex.cn: 不必谢我，我乐意效劳。

ex.en: Thank you very much. It's very kind of you./You really shouldn't have.
ex.cn: 非常感谢。你真是太好了。／您真的不必那么客气。

ex.en: Thank you so much for coming. It was really nice to see you.
ex.cn: 非常感谢你光临。见到你真高兴。

senses.def: used when you are saying who is responsible for sth
senses.chn: 责怪；由…负责；多亏；归功于

ex.en: I have my parents to thank for my success.
ex.cn: 我的成功归功于我的父母。

senses.def: used to tell sb that you are annoyed and do not want them to do sth
senses.chn: （用以表示恼火，不让人做某事）请你…

ex.en: I'll thank you to mind your own business.
ex.cn: 请你少管闲事。

senses.def: used to say that you are pleased about sth

ex.en: Thank God you're safe!
ex.cn: 谢天谢地，你平安无事！

ex.en: 'Thank goodness for that!' she said with a sigh of relief.
ex.cn: “这可要谢天谢地！” 她宽慰地舒了一口气。

senses.def: to feel very grateful and lucky about sth
used to say that sb will not be pleased or will be annoyed about sth

ex.en: John won't thank you for interfering.
ex.cn: 你插手，约翰必定十分恼火。

example.en: I must write and thank Mary for the present.
example.cn: 我得写信感谢玛丽送给我这份礼物。

example.en: She said goodbye and thanked us for coming.
example.cn: 她向我们道别，并感谢我们的光临。

example.en: There's no need to thank me—I enjoyed doing it.
example.cn: 不必谢我，我乐意效劳。

senses.def: pleased about sth good that has happened, or sth bad that has not happened

ex.en: I was thankful to see they'd all arrived safely.
ex.cn: 看到他们都平安到达，我感到欣慰。

ex.en: He wasn't badly hurt—that's something to be thankful for.
ex.cn: 他的伤不重，这倒是值得庆幸。

ex.en: I was thankful that he hadn't been hurt.
ex.cn: 他没有受伤，我感到很欣慰。

ex.en: Well, at least you weren't hurt. I suppose we should be grateful for small mercies.
ex.cn: 好啦，至少你没受伤。我想这就该让我们知足了。

example.en: I was thankful to see they'd all arrived safely.
example.cn: 看到他们都平安到达，我感到欣慰。

example.en: He wasn't badly hurt—that's something to be thankful for.
example.cn: 他的伤不重，这倒是值得庆幸。

example.en: I was thankful that he hadn't been hurt.
example.cn: 他没有受伤，我感到很欣慰。

senses.def: used to show that you are pleased that sth good has happened or that sth bad has been avoided

ex.en: There was a fire in the building, but thankfully no one was hurt.
ex.cn: 大楼失火了，但幸好没有伤着人。

senses.def: in a pleased or grateful way

ex.en: I accepted the invitation thankfully.
ex.cn: 我愉快地接受了邀请。

senses.def: unpleasant or difficult to do and unlikely to bring you any rewards or thanks from anyone
senses.chn: 让人不领情的；徒劳无益的；吃力不讨好的

ex.en: Sometimes being a mother and a housewife felt like a thankless task.
ex.cn: 做母亲和家庭主妇有时使人觉得好像是个受累不讨好的差使。

senses.def: used to show that you are grateful to sb for sth they have done

ex.en: Thanks for lending me the money.
ex.cn: 多谢您借钱给我。

ex.en: Many thanks for your support.
ex.cn: 多谢您的支持。

ex.en: 'How are you?' 'Fine, thanks (= thanks for asking).'
ex.cn: “你好吗？” “挺好的，谢谢。”

senses.def: a polite way of accepting sth that sb has offered you

ex.en: 'Would you like a coffee?' 'Oh, thanks.'
ex.cn: “来杯咖啡好吗？” “好的，谢谢。”

ex.en: 'Here's the change.' ' Thanks very much.'
ex.cn: “这是找你的零钱。” “非常感谢。”

senses.def: a polite way of refusing sth that sb has offered you

ex.en: 'Would you like some more?' 'No thanks.'
ex.cn: “再要一点儿吗？” “不要了，谢谢。”

senses.def: words or actions that show that you are grateful to sb for sth

ex.en: How can I ever express my thanks to you for all you've done?
ex.cn: 对你所做的一切，我怎么才能表达谢意？

ex.en: Thanks are due to all those who worked so hard for so many months.
ex.cn: 感谢这么多月来辛勤工作的每一个人。

ex.en: She murmured her thanks.
ex.cn: 她低声道谢。

senses.def: despite sb/sth; with no help from sb/sth
senses.chn: 虽然；并非由于；不归功于

ex.en: We managed to get it finished in the end—no thanks to him (= he didn't help).
ex.cn: 我们终于把这件事完成了，但这没有他的什么功劳。

senses.def: used to show that you are very grateful to sb for sth they have done

ex.en: Thanks a lot for all you've done.
ex.cn: 多谢你所做的一切。

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed that sb has done sth because it causes trouble or difficulty for you

ex.en: 'I'm afraid I've finished all the milk.' 'Well, thanks a lot!'
ex.cn: “对不起，我把牛奶都喝了。” “哦，多谢了！”

senses.def: used to say that sth has happened because of sb/sth

ex.en: It was all a great success—thanks to a lot of hard work.
ex.cn: 由于尽心竭力，这才大获成功。

ex.en: Everyone knows about it now, thanks to you!
ex.cn: 多亏了你，现在大家都知道了！

example.en: Thanks for lending me the money.
example.cn: 多谢您借钱给我。

example.en: Many thanks for your support.
example.cn: 多谢您的支持。

senses.def: used to show that you are very grateful to sb for sth they have done

ex.en: Thanks a lot for all you've done.
ex.cn: 多谢你所做的一切。

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed that sb has done sth because it causes trouble or difficulty for you

ex.en: 'I'm afraid I've finished all the milk.' 'Well, thanks a lot!'
ex.cn: “对不起，我把牛奶都喝了。” “哦，多谢了！”

senses.def: a public holiday in the US (on the fourth Thursday in November) and in Canada (on the second Monday in October), originally to give thanks to God for the harvest and for health
senses.chn: 感恩节（美国定为十一月的第四个星期四，加拿大定为十月的第二个星期一，均为公休日）

ex.en: We always eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
ex.cn: 我们过感恩节时总是吃火鸡。

ex.en: Are you going home for Thanksgiving?
ex.cn: 你回家过感恩节吗？

senses.def: the expression of thanks to God
used to show that you are grateful to sb for sth they have done

ex.en: Thank you for your letter.
ex.cn: 谢谢你的来信。

ex.en: Thank you very much for sending the photos.
ex.cn: 非常感谢你寄给我这些照片。

senses.def: a polite way of accepting sth that sb has offered you

ex.en: 'Would you like some help with that?' 'Oh, thank you.'
ex.cn: “这事你需要帮忙吗？” “需要，谢谢你。”

senses.def: a polite way of refusing sth that sb has offered you

ex.en: 'Would you like some more cake?' 'No thank you.'
ex.cn: “你要再来点儿蛋糕吗？” “不要了，谢谢你。”

senses.def: used at the end of a sentence to tell sb firmly that you do not need their help or advice
senses.chn: （用于句末，坚决表示不需要帮助或劝告）谢谢

ex.en: 'Shall I do that?' 'I can do it myself, thank you.'
ex.cn: “我来干好吗？” “我自己能干，谢谢。”

senses.def: an act, a gift, a comment, etc. intended to thank sb for sth they have done

ex.en: The actor sent a big thank you to all his fans for their letters of support.
ex.cn: 这位演员向所有来信表示支持的崇拜者表示万分感谢。

ex.en: She took the money without so much as a thank you.
ex.cn: 她接过钱，连一声谢谢都没说。

ex.en: a thank-you letter
ex.cn: 感谢信

example.en: Thank you for your letter.
example.cn: 谢谢你的来信。

example.en: Thank you very much for sending the photos.
example.cn: 非常感谢你寄给我这些照片。

senses.def: to feel very grateful and lucky about sth
used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker or as near to the speaker as another

ex.en: Look at that man over there.
ex.cn: 瞧那边的那个男子。

ex.en: How much are those apples at the back?
ex.cn: 后边那些苹果什么价钱？

senses.def: used for referring to sb/sth that has already been mentioned or is already known about
senses.chn: （指已提到过或已知的人或事物）那，那个

ex.en: I was living with my parents at that time.
ex.cn: 那时候我和父母住在一起。

ex.en: That incident changed their lives.
ex.cn: 那次事件改变了他们的生活。

ex.en: Have you forgotten about that money I lent you last week?
ex.cn: 你忘记上星期我借给你的那笔钱了吧？

ex.en: That dress of hers is too short.
ex.cn: 她那件连衣裙太短了。

senses.def: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker, or not as near to the speaker as another

ex.en: Who's that?
ex.cn: 那是谁？

ex.en: That's Peter over there.
ex.cn: 那边那个人是彼得。

ex.en: Hello. Is that Jo?
ex.cn: 喂，是乔吗？

ex.en: That's a nice dress.
ex.cn: 那件连衣裙很漂亮。

ex.en: Those look riper than these.
ex.cn: 那些看上去比这些熟一些。

senses.def: used for referring to sb/sth that has already been mentioned, or is already known about
senses.chn: （指已提到过或已知的人或事物）那，那个

ex.en: What can I do about that?
ex.cn: 这事我可怎么办？

ex.en: Do you remember when we went to Norway? That was a good trip.
ex.cn: 你记得我们去挪威的情形吗？那次旅行真不错。

ex.en: That's exactly what I think.
ex.cn: 我正是那么想的。

senses.def: used for referring to people or things of a particular type

ex.en: Those present were in favour of change.
ex.cn: 在座的人都赞成变革。

ex.en: There are those who say (= some people say) she should not have got the job.
ex.cn: 有些人说她本不该得到这份工作。

ex.en: Salaries are higher here than those in my country.
ex.cn: 这里的薪水比我国的高。

senses.def: used as a relative pronoun to introduce a part of a sentence which refers to the person, thing or time you have been talking about

ex.en: Where's the letter that came yesterday?
ex.cn: 昨天来的信在哪儿？

ex.en: Who was it that won the US Open?
ex.cn: 在美国公开赛上获胜的是谁？

ex.en: The watch (that) you gave me keeps perfect time.
ex.cn: 您给我的那只表走得很准。

ex.en: The people (that) I spoke to were very helpful.
ex.cn: 我交谈过的人都很肯帮忙。

ex.en: It's the best novel (that) I've ever read.
ex.cn: 这是我读过的最佳小说。

ex.en: We moved here the year (that) my mother died.
ex.cn: 我们是我母亲去世那年搬来的。

senses.def: and everything else connected with an activity, a situation, etc.
senses.chn: 等等；以及诸如此类的事物

ex.en: Did you bring the contract and (all) that?
ex.cn: 合同什么的你都带来了吗？

senses.def: used to say what sth means or to give more information

ex.en: He's a local government administrator, that is to say a civil servant.
ex.cn: 他是地方政府的行政官员，也就是公务员。

ex.en: You'll find her very helpful—if she's not too busy, that is.
ex.cn: 你会觉得她很肯帮忙，那是说如果她不太忙的话。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, i.e. they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，即是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, that is to say, they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，就是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Mnemonic poems, that is poems designed to help you remember something, are an excellent way to learn lists.
ex.cn: 记事诗，即帮助人记起事情的诗歌，是记住一系列事物的极佳方式。

ex.en: A limerick's rhyme scheme is A–A–B–B–A. In other words, the first, second, and fifth lines all rhyme with one another, while the third and fourth lines have their own rhyme.
ex.cn: 五行打油诗的韵律是 A-A-B-B-A。就是说，第一行、第二行和第五行押一个韵，而第三行和第四行押另一个韵。

senses.def: used to say that sb is right, or is doing sth right
senses.chn: （表示某人正确或做得对）就是这样，正是如此，对啦

ex.en: No, the other one… that's it.
ex.cn: 不，另一个…就是它。

ex.en: That's it, carry on!
ex.cn: 对啦！继续！

senses.def: used to say that sth is finished, or that no more can be done
senses.chn: （表示已完成或再也没有可做的了）好了，就这样吧

ex.en: That's it, the fire's out now.
ex.cn: 好了，现在火灭了。

ex.en: That's it for now, but if I get any news I'll let you know.
ex.cn: 现在就这些，如果再得到消息，我就通知你。

ex.en: A week to go, and that's it!
ex.cn: 还有一周，然后就完事了！

senses.def: used to say that you will not accept sth any longer

ex.en: That's it, I've had enough!
ex.cn: 够了，我受够了！

senses.def: used to talk about the reason for sth
senses.chn: （表示理由）就是这个问题，就是这么回事

ex.en: So that's it—the fuse had gone.
ex.cn: 问题就出在这里，保险丝烧断了。

ex.en: You don't love me any more, is that it?
ex.cn: 你不再爱我啦，是不是这样？

senses.def: used to say that your decision cannot be changed
senses.chn: （表示决定不能更改）就是这样，就这样定了

ex.en: Well I'm not going, and that's that.
ex.cn: 好啦，我不去，就这么定了。

senses.def: used after some verbs, adjectives and nouns to introduce a new part of the sentence
senses.chn: （用于某些动词、形容词和名词后，引出从句）

ex.en: She said (that) the story was true.
ex.cn: 她说这件事是真的。

ex.en: It's possible (that) he has not received the letter.
ex.cn: 可能他还没有收到那封信。

ex.en: The fact (that) he's older than me is not relevant.
ex.cn: 他比我年纪大这一事实无关紧要。

senses.def: used to express a result

ex.en: She was so tired (that) she couldn't think straight.
ex.cn: 她累得昏头昏脑。

senses.def: used for expressing a hope or a wish

ex.en: Oh that I could see him again!
ex.cn: 啊，我多么想能再看到他！

senses.def: used when saying how much or showing how long, big, etc. sth is with your hands
senses.chn: （以手势表示长度、大小等时用）那样，那么

ex.en: I can't walk that far (= as far as that).
ex.cn: 我走不了那么远。

ex.en: It's about that long.
ex.cn: 大约有那么长。

senses.def: an object whose name you do not use because you do not need to or want to, or because you do not know it

ex.en: Can you pass me that thing over there?
ex.cn: 把那边那个东西递给我好吗？

ex.en: She's very fond of sweet things (= sweet foods).
ex.cn: 她非常喜欢吃甜食。

ex.en: He's just bought one of those exercise things.
ex.cn: 他刚买了一副健身器械。

ex.en: Turn that thing off while I'm talking to you!
ex.cn: 我在跟你说话，把那个玩意儿关掉！

senses.def: an object that is not alive in the way that people and plants are

ex.en: Don't treat her like that—she's a person, not a thing!
ex.cn: 别那样对待她，她是人，不是物件！

ex.en: He's good at making things with his hands.
ex.cn: 他善于手工制作物品。

ex.en: She took no interest in the people and things around her.
ex.cn: 她对周围的人和事毫无兴趣。

senses.def: objects, clothing or tools that belong to sb or are used for a particular purpose

ex.en: Shall I help you pack your things?
ex.cn: 我帮你打点行装好吗？

ex.en: Bring your swimming things with you.
ex.cn: 随身带上游泳用品。

ex.en: I'll just clear away the breakfast things.
ex.cn: 我这就收拾早餐餐具。

ex.en: Put your things (= coat, etc.) on and let's go.
ex.cn: 把你的衣服穿上，咱们就走。

senses.def: used with negatives to mean 'anything' in order to emphasize what you are saying
senses.chn: 任何东西（用于否定句，加强语气）

ex.en: I haven't got a thing to wear!
ex.cn: 我没有一件可穿的衣服！

ex.en: There wasn't a thing we could do to help.
ex.cn: 没有什么我们能帮得上忙的。

ex.en: Ignore what he said—it doesn't mean a thing.
ex.cn: 别理睬他说的话，他那都是瞎说。

senses.def: a fact, an event, a situation or an action; what sb says or thinks
senses.chn: 事实；事件；情况；行为；话语；想法

ex.en: There are a lot of things she doesn't know about me.
ex.cn: 我有很多情况她都不了解。

ex.en: There's another thing I'd like to ask you.
ex.cn: 还有一件事我想问你。

ex.en: A terrible thing happened last night.
ex.cn: 昨天夜里发生了一件可怕的事情。

ex.en: He found the whole thing (= the situation) very boring.
ex.cn: 他觉得整件事情非常无聊。

ex.en: I've got loads of things to do today.
ex.cn: 今天我有许多事要做。

ex.en: The main thing to remember is to switch off the burglar alarm.
ex.cn: 最要紧的是记住关掉防盗报警器的开关。

senses.def: the general situation, as it affects sb

ex.en: Things haven't gone entirely to plan.
ex.cn: 事态没有完全按照计划发展。

ex.en: Hi, Jane! How are things?
ex.cn: 喂，简，近来怎么样？

ex.en: Think things over before you decide.
ex.cn: 先把情况考虑周全再作决定。

ex.en: As things stand at present, he seems certain to win.
ex.cn: 据目前情况看，他似乎胜券在握。

ex.en: All things considered (= considering all the difficulties or problems), she's done very well.
ex.cn: 通盘考虑起来，她干得很好。

ex.en: Why do you make things so difficult for yourself?
ex.cn: 你为什么这样跟自己过不去？

senses.def: what is needed or socially acceptable
senses.chn: 需要的东西；适当的东西；合适的东西

ex.en: You need something to cheer you up—I know just the thing!
ex.cn: 你需要点什么使你高兴起来，我知道什么正合你的需要！

ex.en: to say the right/wrong thing
ex.cn: 说得体的／不得体的话

ex.en: The best thing to do is to apologize.
ex.cn: 道歉方是上策。

senses.def: all that can be described in a particular way
senses.chn: 所有…的事物；凡是…的东西

ex.en: She loves all things Japanese.
ex.cn: 凡是日本的东西她都喜欢。

senses.def: a living creature

ex.en: All living things are composed of cells.
ex.cn: 所有的生物都由细胞组成。

senses.def: used to talk to or about a person or an animal, to show how you feel about them
senses.chn: （指人或动物，带感情色彩）人，家伙，东西

ex.en: You silly thing!
ex.cn: 你这个蠢货！

ex.en: You must be starving, you poor things.
ex.cn: 你们一定是饿坏了，你们这些可怜的家伙。

ex.en: The cat's very ill, poor old thing.
ex.cn: 这猫病得很厉害，真可怜。

senses.def: B is very different from A, for example it is more difficult, serious or important
senses.chn: …是一回事，…是另一回事；…和…截然不同

ex.en: Romance is one thing, marriage is quite another.
ex.cn: 爱情是一回事，婚姻却是另一回事。

ex.en: It's one thing to tease your sister, but it's another to hit her.
ex.cn: 逗你妹妹玩是一回事，但打她那就另当别论了。

senses.def: if the conditions stay the same; if other conditions are the same
senses.chn: 如果所有条件保持不变；如果其他情况一样

ex.en: All things being equal, we should finish the job tomorrow.
ex.cn: 一切照常的话，我们明天应该完成这项工作。

senses.def: used when you do not want to complete a list

ex.en: She likes nice clothes and things like that.
ex.cn: 她喜欢漂亮衣服之类的东西。

ex.en: I've been busy shopping and things.
ex.cn: 我一直忙于购物之类的事情。

senses.def: to please everyone by changing your attitudes or opinions to suit different people
to be understood or used in different ways by different people
to have the same result or meaning
to be lucky that…

ex.en: It's a good thing we got here early.
ex.cn: 幸亏我们早到了这儿。

senses.def: used to say that although sth seems to be bad, it could have good results
senses.chn: 并不是坏事；或许是好事

ex.en: We didn't want the press to get hold of the story, but it might be no bad thing.
ex.cn: 我们本不想让新闻界知道这事，但是知道了也许并非是坏事。

senses.def: to have found a job, situation or style of life that is pleasant or easy
senses.chn: 找到称心的工作；过上舒心的日子；混得不错

senses.def: to have a powerful emotional effect on sb
senses.chn: 使某人十分激动；震撼某人

ex.en: That song just does things to me.
ex.cn: 一听到那首歌我就激动不已。

senses.def: to do what you want to do or what interests you, without thinking about other people; to be independent
senses.chn: 做自己想做的事；照自己的意愿行事；独立自主；自行其事

senses.def: early in the morning/late in the evening
senses.chn: 一早／晚上最后（要做的事）

ex.en: I need the report on my desk first thing Monday morning.
ex.cn: 星期一一早这个报告就得放在我的办公桌上。

senses.def: the most important matters must be dealt with first
senses.chn: 最重要的事最早办；要事先办

ex.en: We have a lot to discuss, but, first things first, let's have a cup of coffee!
ex.cn: 我们有许多事要讨论，不过急事先办，咱们先喝杯咖啡吧！

senses.def: used to introduce one of two or more reasons for doing sth
senses.chn: （用以引出两个以上的理由之一）一来，一方面

ex.en: 'Why don't you get a car?' 'Well, for one thing, I can't drive!'
ex.cn: “你为什么不买辆汽车呢？” “啊，首先，我不会开车！”

senses.def: to have a strong like or dislike of sb/sth in a way that seems strange or unreasonable
senses.chn: （莫名其妙地）对…有好感，对…有偏见

ex.en: She has a thing about men with beards.
ex.cn: 她对留胡子的男人有强烈的感觉。

senses.def: it isn't sth that you really enjoy or are interested in
senses.chn: 这不是我（或他等）真正喜欢的东西；并非…所好

senses.def: it is sth that only a particular group understands
senses.chn: 这是…的事（只有某群体才理解的）

ex.en: You wouldn't know what it means—it's a girl thing.
ex.cn: 你不会知道那是什么意思，那是女孩子家的事。

senses.def: to know/tell sb some useful, interesting or surprising information about sb/sth
senses.chn: 了解／透露有用的（或有趣的、意外的）信息；有所了解／披露；见多识广

ex.en: She's been married five times, so she knows a thing or two about men!
ex.cn: 她结过五次婚，所以对男人有所了解。

senses.def: to make sth seem more important than it really is
senses.chn: 小题大做；大惊小怪；故弄玄虚

senses.def: to know nothing at all about sth/sb
senses.chn: 对…一无所知；对…一窍不通

senses.def: not considered socially acceptable
senses.chn: 不太合时宜；不太时兴；不得体

ex.en: It wouldn't be quite the thing to turn up in running gear.
ex.cn: 穿着跑步的运动服出现在这场合可不大成体统。

senses.def: not healthy or normal
used to say that you do not want to discuss or think about sth bad or unpleasant that has happened, but just accept it
senses.chn: 命中注定的事；难免的倒霉事；不可挽回的事

ex.en: It wasn't your fault. It was just one of those things.
ex.cn: 不是你的错。这是命中注定的事。

senses.def: used to complain that a lot of unpleasant things keep happening to you
senses.chn: （抱怨时用）倒霉事一桩接一桩

senses.def: used to suggest that the way one event or action leads to others is so obvious that it does not need to be stated
senses.chn: （暗示事情的发展过程显而易见）一来二去，自然而然

ex.en: He offered me a ride home one night, and, well, one thing led to another and now we're married!
ex.cn: 一天晚上他让我搭车回家，唔，就这样自然发展，我们现在结婚了！

senses.def: to imagine that you can see or hear sth that is in fact not there
there is only one possible course of action
used to say that you should accept an unpleasant situation or event because you cannot change it
senses.chn: （表示无法改变，应该接受）这些都是对我们的考验（或磨炼）

senses.def: used to introduce an important fact, reason or explanation

ex.en: I'm sorry my assignment isn't finished. The thing is, I've had a lot of other work this week.
ex.cn: 对不起，我的任务没完成。主要原因是我这星期有许多其他工作要做。

senses.def: used to introduce a problem about sth/sb

ex.en: The thing with Karl is, he's always late.
ex.cn: 卡尔的问题是，他总是迟到。

senses.def: a situation or an activity of the type mentioned

ex.en: She really didn't want to be involved in the whole family thing.
ex.cn: 她实在不想卷入家事之中。

senses.def: used to refer to ghosts and other supernatural things that cannot be explained
senses.chn: 夜里奇异可怕的响声；鬼魂；超自然现象

senses.def: used to say that, although sth is pleasant, you do not want to have too much of it
because you have been busy with various problems, events or things you had to do
senses.chn: 因为事情一个接着一个；由于忙得不可开交

ex.en: I completely forgot her birthday, what with one thing and another.
ex.cn: 因为忙得不可开交，我把她的生日忘得一干二净。

senses.def: people say chance would be a fine thing to show that they would like to do or have the thing that sb has mentioned, but that they do not think that it is very likely
a situation in which success or failure is equally possible

ex.en: We got him out in the end, but it was a close thing.
ex.cn: 我们最后总算把他救了出来，可那是真险啊。

senses.def: a situation in which sb only just wins or loses, for example in a competition or an election
senses.chn: （比赛或选举等中的）险胜，差距很小的败北

senses.def: to not think about what will happen in the future
senses.chn: 得过且过；做一天和尚撞一天钟；过一天算一天

ex.en: I don't know if he'll get better. We're just taking it one day at a time.
ex.cn: 我不知道他还能不能好转，我们只有过一天算一天。

senses.def: to do what people or society expect, especially in a difficult situation
senses.chn: （尤指在困境中）做人心所向的事，做体面事

ex.en: He did the decent thing and resigned.
ex.cn: 他做得很体面，辞职了。

senses.def: to be socially acceptable behaviour
senses.chn: 是合乎礼仪的行为；是得体的行为

senses.def: to relax and avoid working too hard or doing too much

ex.en: The doctor told me to take it easy for a few weeks.
ex.cn: 医生叫我休息几周。

senses.def: in the way that things usually happen

ex.en: In the nature of things, young people often rebel against their parents.
ex.cn: 年轻人常常会反抗他们的父母，这很自然。

senses.def: a situation in which you are successful, but which could also have ended badly

ex.en: Phew! That was a near thing! It could have been a disaster.
ex.cn: 哎呀！好险哪！差一点儿出事。

ex.en: We won in the end but it was a near thing.
ex.cn: 我们最后赢了，但是险胜。

senses.def: used before mentioning a worry or problem you have with sth
senses.chn: 问题是；麻烦的是；只是；不过

ex.en: I'd love to come—the only thing is I might be late.
ex.cn: 我很想去，只不过我可能会迟到。

senses.def: to work, study, etc. too hard or for too long

ex.en: He's been overdoing things recently.
ex.cn: 他最近过于努力了。

ex.en: I overdid it in the gym and hurt my back.
ex.cn: 我在健身房练得过火了，结果弄伤了背。

senses.def: to take a risk because you have successfully avoided problems in the past
senses.chn: （由于过去的成功过关）再冒一次险，继续碰运气

ex.en: You didn't get caught last time, but don't push your luck!
ex.cn: 上次没被逮住，但你不要再心存侥幸了！

senses.def: the genuine thing

ex.en: Are you sure it's the real thing (= love), not just infatuation?
ex.cn: 你能确定这是真爱，而非一时痴迷？

senses.def: the way things seem to be organized; the way sb wants everything to be organized

ex.en: My personal problems are not really important in the overall scheme of things.
ex.cn: 从全局来看，我个人的问题并非十分重要。

ex.en: I don't think marriage figures in his scheme of things.
ex.cn: 我想，婚姻在他的心目中是无足轻重的。

senses.def: the way things are likely to develop in the future
used to say 'yes' to a suggestion or request

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'Sure thing.'
ex.cn: “你来吗？” “当然。”

senses.def: as was shown or proved by later events
senses.chn: 正如后来表明的；果然如此；果不其然

ex.en: I didn't need my umbrella, as it turned out (= because it didn't rain).
ex.cn: 我果然没用上我的伞。

senses.def: to have what you want, especially by opposing other people
to arrange sth in a particular way, especially by being clever

ex.en: Can you work it so that we get free tickets?
ex.cn: 你能不能为我们搞到些免费票？

things that go bump in the night.lemma: things that go bump in the night

senses.def: used to refer to ghosts and other supernatural things that cannot be explained
senses.chn: 夜里奇异可怕的响声；鬼魂；超自然现象

senses.def: used to refer to a person or thing whose name you do not know or have forgotten, or which you do not want to mention
senses.chn: （指不知、或忘记、或不想提及其名）某某，那个人，那东西

ex.en: It's one of those thingummies for keeping papers together.
ex.cn: 就是能收纳文件的那么一种东西。

ex.en: Is thingummy going to be there? You know, that woman from the Sales Department?
ex.cn: 某某人会去那儿吗？你知道，就是销售部的那个女的。

senses.def: to have a particular idea or opinion about sth/sb; to believe sth

ex.en: Do you think (that) they'll come?
ex.cn: 你认为他们会来吗？

ex.en: I thought I heard a scream.
ex.cn: 我好像听到了一声尖叫。

ex.en: I didn't think you liked sports.
ex.cn: 我原以为你不喜好运动。

ex.en: Am I right in thinking that you used to live here?
ex.cn: 我想你过去在这里住过，对吗？

ex.en: I think this is their house, but I'm not sure.
ex.cn: 我想这是他们的家，但不敢肯定。

ex.en: He ought to resign, I think.
ex.cn: 我看他应该辞职。

senses.def: to use your mind to consider sth, to form connected ideas, to try to solve problems, etc.

ex.en: Are animals able to think?
ex.cn: 动物会思考吗？

ex.en: Let me think (= give me time before I answer).
ex.cn: 让我想一想。

ex.en: I can't tell you now—I'll have to think about it.
ex.cn: 我现在无法告诉你，我得考虑一下。

ex.en: She had thought very deeply about this problem.
ex.cn: 她曾经对这个问题深深思考过。

ex.en: All he ever thinks about is money.
ex.cn: 他满脑子想的只是钱。

ex.en: I'm sorry, I wasn't thinking (= said when you have upset or offended sb accidentally).
ex.cn: 对不起，我太冒昧了。

senses.def: to have ideas, words or images in your mind

ex.en: You're very quiet. What are you thinking?
ex.cn: 你一声不吭，在想什么？

ex.en: I was just thinking what a long way it is.
ex.cn: 我刚才在琢磨路途太远了。

ex.en: 'I must be crazy,' she thought.
ex.cn: “我准是疯了。” 她想。

senses.def: to form an idea of sth; to imagine sth

ex.en: We couldn't think where you'd gone.
ex.cn: 我们猜想不出来你到哪里去了。

ex.en: Just think how nice it would be to see them again.
ex.cn: 试想一下要是能再见到他们该有多好。

ex.en: I can't think (that) he would be so stupid.
ex.cn: 我不能想象他会这么蠢。

ex.en: Just think —we'll be lying on the beach this time tomorrow.
ex.cn: 想想看，明天这个时候我们就躺在海滩上了。

ex.en: If I'm late home, my mother always thinks the worst.
ex.cn: 如果我回家晚了，我母亲总是往最坏处想。

ex.en: Try to think yourself into the role.
ex.cn: 尽量发挥想象力，使自己进入角色。

senses.def: to expect sth

ex.en: I never thought (that) I'd see her again.
ex.cn: 我从未料想到还会见到她。

ex.en: The job took longer than we thought.
ex.cn: 这项工作用的时间比我们预想的多。

ex.en: You'd think she'd have been grateful for my help (= but she wasn't).
ex.cn: 你还期望她会对我的帮助感恩戴德呢。

ex.en: Who would have thought to find you here?
ex.cn: 谁会料到你在这儿呢？

senses.def: to think in a particular way or on a particular subject

ex.en: Let's think positive.
ex.cn: 咱们往好的方面想吧。

ex.en: You need to think big (= aim to achieve a lot).
ex.cn: 你要敢想。

ex.en: If you want to make money, you've got to think money.
ex.cn: 你要想赚钱，就得一门心思琢磨钱。

senses.def: used in questions to show that you are angry or surprised

ex.en: What do you think you're doing?
ex.cn: 你以为你在干什么？

senses.def: used to make sth you say sound less definite or more polite
senses.chn: （用于使话语不太肯定或较为婉转）

ex.en: I thought we could go out tonight.
ex.cn: 我本想我们今晚可以出去。

ex.en: Twenty guests are enough, I would have thought.
ex.cn: 我觉得二十位客人就够了。

ex.en: Do you think you could open the window?
ex.cn: 请打开窗子好吗？

ex.en: 'You've made a mistake.' 'I don't think so.'
ex.cn: “你出错了。” “我想不会吧。”

senses.def: to intend sth; to have a plan about sth

ex.en: I think I'll go for a swim.
ex.cn: 我想去游泳。

ex.en: I'm thinking in terms of about 70 guests at the wedding.
ex.cn: 我打算邀请 70 位嘉宾参加婚礼。

senses.def: to remember sth; to have sth come into your mind

ex.en: I didn't think (= it did not occur to me) to tell her.
ex.cn: 我没有想到要告诉她。

ex.en: I can't think where I put the keys.
ex.cn: 我想不起把钥匙放在哪儿了。

senses.def: used when you suddenly remember sth or realize that it might be important
senses.chn: （用于突然想起某事或认识到其重要性）想起来了，的确

ex.en: Come to think of it, he did mention seeing you.
ex.cn: 想起来了，他确实提到看见过你。

senses.def: used to say very strongly that you do not agree with sth, or that sth is not possible
senses.chn: 我想并非如此；我不这样认为；根本不可能

ex.en: Me? Fail? I don't think so.
ex.cn: 我？失败？我可不这样认为。

senses.def: used to draw attention to a fact that is not obvious or has not previously been mentioned
senses.chn: （用以引起对不明显或未曾提到过的事情的注意）你想想看

ex.en: It was a difficult situation, when you think about it.
ex.cn: 仔细想来，当时处境是很困难的。

senses.def: that is what I expected or suspected
senses.chn: 我早料到了；果然不出我所料

ex.en: 'He said he'd forgotten.' 'I thought as much.'
ex.cn: “他说忘了。” “果然不出我所料。”

senses.def: to consider a situation again and perhaps change your idea or intention
senses.chn: 重新考虑后另作打算（常指最终改变主意）

senses.def: to say what your thoughts are as you have them
senses.chn: 自言自语；边想边说；进行有声思考

senses.def: to decide not to do sth after thinking further about it
senses.chn: 深思熟虑后决定不做；一想又改变主意

ex.en: Rosie was about to protest but thought better of it.
ex.cn: 罗西刚要抗议，但又一想决定作罢。

senses.def: to have a higher opinion of sb

ex.en: She has behaved appallingly—I must say I thought better of her.
ex.cn: 她的行为太恶劣了，看来我过去是高看了她。

senses.def: used as a polite response when sb has said sorry to you or thanked you
to consider an activity to be normal and not particularly unusual or difficult
senses.chn: 不把…当一回事；对…等闲视之；觉得…无所谓

ex.en: He stepped across the threshold.
ex.cn: 他迈过门槛。

the habit of saving money and spending it carefully so that none is wasted
a wild plant with bright pink flowers that grows by the sea/ocean

ex.en: I was thrilled by your news.

ex.cn: 我隔墙听不到他们的交谈。

ex.cn: 透过薄雾他勉强能看出有三个人。

ex.cn: 他活不过今天晚上了。

ex.cn: 你穿过这道大门，就看到左面的房子了。

ex.cn: 公园从 5 月 1 日到 10 月 31 日开放。

ex.cn: 你得孜孜不倦方能成功。

ex.cn: 我全靠他的帮助才找到这份工作。

ex.cn: 围观的人闪开一条路，让医务辅助人员通过。

ex.cn: 先别告诉我书的结尾，我还没有看完呢。

ex.cn: 我想我会挨到发薪日的。

ex.cn: 红灯亮着，但他开车闯了过去。

ex.cn: 我们队打进了半决赛。

ex.cn: 这列火车直达约克。

ex.cn: 请接线员把电话直接接给我本人。

ex.cn: 我给你打电话了，可是怎么也打不通。

ex.cn: 我们浑身上下都湿透了。

ex.cn: 他是地地道道的英国人。

ex.cn: 这个博物馆一年到头每天都开放。

ex.cn: 仪式进行了两个小时，我们自始至终都得站着。

any of the small flat pieces that are used in particular board games
to stay out late enjoying yourself
to cover a surface with tiles

ex.cn: 铺瓷砖的浴室

senses.def: to arrange several windows on a computer screen so that they fill the screen but do not cover each other
senses.chn: 平铺显示，并列显示，瓦片式显示（视窗）

an area covered with tiles
the work of covering a floor, wall, etc. with tiles
the place where you pay for goods in a large shop/store

ex.en: Please pay at the till.
ex.cn: 请在交款处付款。

ex.en: a long queue at the till
ex.cn: 收款处的长队

the process of preparing and using land for growing crops

senses.chn: 直到世界末日；很长时间；永远

ex.en: This job's going to take me till doomsday.
ex.cn: 这项工作要花去我一生一世的心血。

senses.def: a bar that is used to turn the rudder of a small boat in order to steer it
for a very long time; for ever
to move, or make sth move, into a position with one side or end higher than the other

ex.en: Suddenly the boat tilted to one side.
ex.cn: 小船突然倾向一侧。

ex.en: The seat tilts forward, when you press this lever.
ex.cn: 按这个控制柄，座位就向前倾斜。

ex.en: His hat was tilted slightly at an angle.
ex.cn: 他的帽子有点歪。

ex.en: She tilted her head back and looked up at me with a smile.
ex.cn: 她仰起头含笑看着我。

senses.def: to make sth/sb change slightly so that one particular opinion, person, etc. is preferred or more likely to succeed than another; to change in this way
senses.chn: 使倾向于；使向…倾斜；偏向

ex.en: The conditions may tilt the balance in favour of the Kenyan runners.
ex.cn: 这些条件可能对肯尼亚赛跑运动员有利。

ex.en: Popular opinion has tilted in favour of the socialists.
ex.cn: 公众舆论已倒向社会党人一边。

senses.def: to waste your energy attacking imaginary enemies
to attack sb/sth in speech or writing
to try to win sth

ex.en: He was tilting at the top prize.
ex.cn: 他在力争夺魁。

senses.def: a position in which one end or side of sth is higher than the other; an act of tilting sth to one side

ex.en: The table is at a slight tilt.
ex.cn: 这桌子有点儿倾斜。

ex.en: He answered with a tilt of his head.
ex.cn: 他歪着头回答。

senses.def: an attempt to win sth or defeat sb
senses.chn: （意欲赢得某物或战胜某人的）企图，尝试

ex.en: She aims to have a tilt at the world championship next year.
ex.cn: 她的目标是明年问鼎世界冠军。

senses.def: as fast as possible

example.en: Suddenly the boat tilted to one side.
example.cn: 小船突然倾向一侧。

example.en: His hat was tilted slightly at an angle.
example.cn: 他的帽子有点歪。

senses.def: to try to win sth

ex.en: He was tilting at the top prize.
ex.cn: 他在力争夺魁。

senses.def: to waste your energy attacking imaginary enemies
trees that are grown to be used in building or for making things
senses.chn: （用于建筑或制作物品的）树木，林木；用材林

ex.en: the timber industry
ex.cn: 林木业

senses.def: wood that is prepared for use in building, etc.

ex.en: houses built of timber
ex.cn: 木屋

senses.def: a long heavy piece of wood used in building a house or ship
senses.chn: （建造房屋用的）大木料，栋木；（造船用的）肋材

ex.en: roof timbers
ex.cn: 房檩

built of timbers; with a framework of timbers
a place where wood for building, etc. is stored and sold
the quality of sound that is produced by a particular voice or musical instrument
a place that is very far away
what is measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.
senses.chn: （以分钟、小时、天等计量的）时间

ex.en: The changing seasons mark the passing of time.
ex.cn: 寒来暑往，斗转星移。

ex.en: A visit to the museum will take you back in time to the 1930s.
ex.cn: 参观这家博物馆就会使你回到 20 世纪 30 年代。

ex.en: time and space
ex.cn: 时间和空间

ex.en: As time went by we saw less and less of each other.
ex.cn: 随着时间的推移，我们见面越来越少。

ex.en: Perceptions change over time (= as time passes).
ex.cn: 观念随着时间的流逝而变化。

senses.def: the time shown on a clock in minutes and hours
senses.chn: （钟表所显示的）时间，钟点，时刻

ex.en: What time is it/What's the time?
ex.cn: 几点了？

ex.en: Do you have the time?
ex.cn: 你知道现在几点了吗？

ex.en: What time do you make it?
ex.cn: 你说现在几点了？

ex.en: What time do you have?
ex.cn: 你知道现在几点了吗？

ex.en: The time is now half past ten.
ex.cn: 现在是十点半。

ex.en: Can she tell the time yet (= say what time it is by looking at a clock)?
ex.cn: 她会看钟表了吗？

senses.def: the time measured in a particular part of the world
senses.chn: （世界某一地区所计量的）时，时间

ex.en: Greenwich Mean Time
ex.cn: 格林尼治平时

ex.en: 6 o'clock local time
ex.cn: 当地时间 6 点钟

senses.def: the time when sth happens or when sth should happen
senses.chn: （某事发生或应该发生的）时间，时候

ex.en: What time do you finish work?
ex.cn: 你什么时候下班？

ex.en: The baby loves bath time.
ex.cn: 这婴儿喜欢洗澡的时候。

ex.en: I think it's time to go to bed.
ex.cn: 我想该睡觉了。

ex.en: It's time for lunch.
ex.cn: 午餐时间到了。

ex.en: It's time the kids were in bed.
ex.cn: 孩子们该睡觉了。

ex.en: By the time you get there the meeting will be over.
ex.cn: 等你到了那里的时候，会议就该结束了。

senses.def: an amount of time; the amount of time available to work, rest, etc.
senses.chn: 一段时间；（可用于工作、休息等的）一段时间

ex.en: Allow plenty of time to get to the airport.
ex.cn: 预留足够的时间到达机场。

ex.en: I can probably make the time to see them.
ex.cn: 我大概能腾出时间见他们。

ex.en: It takes time to make changes in the law.
ex.cn: 修改法律还有待时日。

ex.en: We have no time to lose (= we must hurry).
ex.cn: 我们不能耽误时间了！

ex.en: He spends most of his time working.
ex.cn: 他把大部分时间都花在工作上。

ex.en: She doesn't have much free/spare time.
ex.cn: 她没有多少空余时间。

senses.def: a period of time, either long or short, during which you do sth or sth happens

ex.en: His injuries will take a long time to heal.
ex.cn: 他的伤需要很长一段时间才能好。

ex.en: I lived in Egypt for a time.
ex.cn: 我在埃及住过一阵子。

ex.en: The early morning is the best time of day.
ex.cn: 清晨是一天最好的时光。

ex.en: Her parents died a long time ago.
ex.cn: 她的父母很早以前就去世了。

ex.en: At one time (= at a period of time in the past) Emily was my best friend.
ex.cn: 埃米莉一度是我最好的朋友。

ex.en: Mr Curtis was the manager in my time (= when I was working there).
ex.cn: 我在那里工作时，柯蒂斯先生是经理。

senses.def: a period of history connected with particular events or experiences in people's lives

ex.en: The movie is set at the time of the Russian Revolution.
ex.cn: 这部电影以俄国革命时期为背景。

ex.en: in ancient times
ex.cn: 在古代

ex.en: the violent times we live in (= the present period of history)
ex.cn: 我们生逢的乱世

ex.en: Times are hard for the unemployed.
ex.cn: 对失业者来说，时世艰难。

ex.en: Times have changed since Grandma was young.
ex.cn: 世易时移，现在已不是祖母年轻时那会儿了。

senses.def: an occasion when you do sth or when sth happens

ex.en: Every time I hear that song I feel happy.
ex.cn: 我每次听到那首歌都感到很愉快。

ex.en: Next time you're here let's have lunch together.
ex.cn: 下次你到这里来，咱们一起吃午饭。

ex.en: He failed his driving test three times.
ex.cn: 他考了三次驾驶执照都没通过。

ex.en: He's determined to pass this time.
ex.cn: 这一回他决心要考及格。

ex.en: When was the last time you saw her?
ex.cn: 你上次是什么时候见到她的？

ex.en: How many times (= how often) do I have to tell you not to do that?
ex.cn: 我得要跟你说多少回不要做那种事？

senses.def: an event or occasion that you experience in a particular way
senses.chn: （以某种方式经历的）事件，时刻

ex.en: Did you have a good time in Spain?
ex.cn: 你在西班牙过得愉快吗？

ex.en: I had an awful time in the hospital.
ex.cn: 我住院的日子可真难熬。

senses.def: how long sb takes to run a race or complete an event
senses.chn: （完成赛跑或竞赛项目的）所用时间

ex.en: The winner's time was 11.6 seconds.
ex.cn: 获胜者的时间是 11.6 秒。

ex.en: She completed the 500 metres in record time (= faster than any previous runner).
ex.cn: 她以破纪录的时间跑完了 500 米。

ex.en: one of the fastest times ever
ex.cn: 历来最快的成绩之一

senses.def: the number of beats in a bar/ measure of music

ex.en: This piece is in four-four time.
ex.cn: 这首乐曲为四分之四拍。

ex.en: a slow waltz time
ex.cn: 缓慢的华尔兹节拍

ex.en: The conductor beat time with a baton.
ex.cn: 指挥用指挥棒打拍子。

senses.def: the correct speed and rhythm of a piece of music

ex.en: Try and dance in time to the music (= with the same speed and rhythm).
ex.cn: 要跟上音乐的节奏跳舞。

ex.en: Clap your hands to keep time (= sing or move with the correct speed and rhythm).
ex.cn: 拍手以保持节奏。

ex.en: to play in/out of time (= follow/not follow the correct speed and rhythm)
ex.cn: 演奏得合／不合节奏

ex.en: He always plays in perfect time.
ex.cn: 他演奏的节奏总是准确无误。

senses.def: used to say that sth should have happened before now
if you do sth against time, you do it as fast as you can because you do not have much time

ex.en: They're working against time to try and get people out of the rubble alive.
ex.cn: 他们正在争分夺秒，设法把人们从瓦砾中活着救出来。

senses.def: earlier/later than was expected

ex.en: We finished 15 minutes ahead of time.
ex.cn: 我们提前 15 分钟完成。

senses.def: having advanced or new ideas that other people use or copy later
senses.chn: 超越时代的；有超前意识的；具有前瞻性的

senses.def: during the whole of a particular period of time

ex.en: The letter was in my pocket all the time (= while I was looking for it).
ex.cn: 这信一直就在我的口袋里。

senses.def: very often; repeatedly

ex.en: She leaves the lights on all the time.
ex.cn: 她总是让灯亮着。

senses.def: always

ex.en: Our representatives are ready to help you at all times.
ex.cn: 我们的代表随时准备帮助你。

senses.def: even when the circumstances are very good

ex.en: He's never very happy at the best of times—he'll be much worse now!
ex.cn: 他即使在处境最好的时候也从未很高兴过，现在就更糟了！

senses.def: at one time; together

ex.en: She was laughing and crying at the same time.
ex.cn: 她又哭又笑。

senses.def: used to introduce a contrasting fact, etc. that must be considered
senses.chn: （用以引出必须予以考虑的相对情况）同时，也，然而，不过

ex.en: You have to be firm, but at the same time you should try and be sympathetic.
ex.cn: 你必须要严格，不过也应尽量怀有同情心。

senses.def: separately or in groups of two, three, etc. on each occasion

ex.en: We had to go and see the principal one at a time.
ex.cn: 我们得逐一去见校长。

ex.en: She ran up the stairs two at a time.
ex.cn: 她一步两阶地跑上楼梯。

senses.def: at the age you are (especially when you are not young)
senses.chn: 在…这样的年纪（尤指不年轻时）

ex.en: Eyesight doesn't get any better at my time of life.
ex.cn: 到我这把年纪，视力绝不会变好的。

senses.def: sometimes

ex.en: He can be really bad-tempered at times.
ex.cn: 他有的时候脾气可真坏。

senses.def: happening before you were born or can remember or before you lived, worked, etc. somewhere
senses.chn: 在…出生（或记事、在世、工作等）之前

ex.en: 'Were you taught by Professor Pascal?' 'No, he was before my time.'
ex.cn: “帕斯卡尔教授教过你吗？” “没有，他教书时我还没有入校呢。”

senses.def: before the usual time in sb's life when sth happens

ex.en: She got old before her time.
ex.cn: 她过早地衰老了。

senses.def: old-fashioned in your ideas, methods, etc.
to spend time in prison
whenever there is a choice

ex.en: I don't really like cities—give me the countryside every time.
ex.cn: 我真不太喜欢城市，一有机会就让我去乡村吧。

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

ex.en: You can leave your suitcase here for the time being.
ex.cn: 你可以暂时把衣箱留在这儿。

senses.def: occasionally but not regularly

ex.en: She has to work at weekends from time to time.
ex.cn: 她偶尔周末还得工作。

senses.def: to like and be interested in sb/sth
senses.chn: 喜欢；对…感兴趣；愿意为…花时间

senses.def: to dislike sb/sth
senses.chn: 不喜欢；讨厌；不愿为…花时间

ex.en: I have no time for lazy people like Steve.
ex.cn: 我讨厌像史蒂夫这样的懒汉。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much
to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.chn: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着

senses.def: early; with enough time so that you are not in a hurry
used to say that sth will be done or will happen at the appropriate time and not before
senses.chn: 会按时做（或出现）；不消多久

ex.en: Be patient, Emily! All in good time.
ex.cn: 埃米莉，别急！快好了。

senses.def: so soon or so quickly that it is surprising
senses.chn: 短暂（或快）得令人吃惊；立刻；马上；一会儿

ex.en: The kids will be leaving home in no time.
ex.cn: 孩子们很快就要离开家了。

senses.def: after a period of time when a situation has changed
senses.chn: 经过一段时间之后；迟早；最后；终于

ex.en: They learned to accept their stepmother in time.
ex.cn: 过了一段时间之后他们学着接受他们的继母。

senses.def: not late; with enough time to be able to do sth

ex.en: Will we be in time for the six o'clock train?
ex.cn: 我们来得及赶上六点钟的那趟火车吗？

ex.en: The ambulance got there just in time (= to save sb's life).
ex.cn: 救护车及时赶到那里。

senses.def: when you are ready and not sooner

ex.en: Don't hassle him! He'll do it in his own good time.
ex.cn: 别唠唠叨叨地烦他了！他准备好时就会做的。

senses.def: in your free time and not when you usually work or study
used to say that you think sb should do sth soon
senses.chn: 差不多／现在是…的时候了

ex.en: It's about time you cleaned your room!
ex.cn: 你该打扫自己的房间了！

senses.def: to change and develop your ideas, way of working, etc. so that you do what is modern and what is expected
to complete a journey quickly

ex.en: We made excellent time and arrived in Spain in two days.
ex.cn: 我们一路很顺当，两天后就到了西班牙。

senses.def: many times; frequently
used to say that sth is usually true or almost always happens

ex.en: Nine times out of ten she gives the right answer.
ex.cn: 她的答案十有八九是对的。

senses.def: to refuse to speak to sb because you do not like or respect them

ex.en: Since the success of her novel, people shake her hand who once wouldn't have given her the time of day.
ex.cn: 自从她的小说获得成功之后，曾经懒得答理她的人也跟她握起手来。

senses.def: now is the best time to do sth, not in the future
senses.chn: 现在是做…的最佳时机；现在不做更待何时

senses.def: that has ever existed
senses.chn: 自古以来；有史以来；从未有过

ex.en: Many rated him the best singer of all time.
ex.cn: 许多人认为他是有史以来最优秀的歌手。

senses.def: to use as much time as you need without hurrying

ex.en: There's no rush—take your time.
ex.cn: 别着急，慢慢来。

senses.def: used to say you think sb is late or is too slow in doing sth
senses.chn: 迟到；慢慢腾腾；磨磨蹭蹭

ex.en: You certainly took your time getting here!
ex.cn: 你真是姗姗来迟啊！

senses.def: to spend some time away from your usual work or activity in order to rest or do sth else instead
senses.chn: 抽出时间（暂停工作或活动）；忙里偷闲

ex.en: She is taking time out from her music career for a year.
ex.cn: 她将抽出一年的时间，暂不从事音乐事业。

ex.en: We stopped for a well-earned rest.
ex.cn: 我们停下来作个应有的休息。

ex.en: Let's take a break.
ex.cn: 咱们休息一会儿吧。

ex.en: The drug brought a brief respite from the pain.
ex.cn: 药物暂时缓解了疼痛。

ex.en: Take time out to relax by the pool.
ex.cn: 去游泳池边歇一歇吧。

ex.en: This delay gives the party a breathing space in which to sort out its policies.
ex.cn: 这一延误使该党有了喘息之机来厘定其政策。

senses.def: often; on many or all occasions
senses.chn: 一次又一次；一再；屡屡；总是

ex.en: You will get a perfect result time after time if you follow these instructions.
ex.cn: 如果你遵循这些用法说明，每次都会得到最佳的效果。

senses.def: one and a half times the usual rate of pay
time seems to pass very quickly
senses.chn: 时间过得真快；光阴似箭；时光飞逝

ex.en: How time flies! I've got to go now.
ex.cn: 时间过得真快！现在我得走了。

ex.en: Time has flown since the holiday began.
ex.cn: 假日一开始，时间就过得飞快。

senses.def: time is valuable, and should not be wasted
senses.chn: 时间就是金钱；一寸光阴一寸金

senses.def: used to say that sb can wait for sth to happen or can wait before doing sth
senses.chn: 有的是时间（等待某事发生或做某事）

senses.def: on the next, first, etc. occasion that the same thing happens
senses.chn: 同样的事情下次（或第一次等）发生时

ex.en: He repeated none of the errors he'd made first time round.
ex.cn: 他没有重复过首次所犯下的任何错误。

ex.en: This time round it was not so easy.
ex.cn: 这一次这事可就不那么容易了。

senses.def: used to say that sth used to happen in the past
senses.chn: 曾经有那么个时候…；那年头…

senses.def: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

ex.en: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
ex.cn: 只有时间才能证明这种疗法是否成功。

senses.def: to mark or follow the rhythm of music, by waving a stick, tapping your foot, etc.

ex.en: She beat time with her fingers.
ex.cn: 她用手指打拍子。

senses.def: to wait for the right time to do sth
to still be alive after the time when you were expected to die
to be doing sth that other people are likely to soon stop you from doing

senses.def: to not care at all about sb/sth
to continue to disagree about a decision, especially when it is too late to change it or it is not very important
senses.chn: （对决定）徒然反对，作无谓的争执

example.en: I tossed the book aside and got up.
example.cn: 我把书丢在一边，站了起来。

example.en: He tossed the ball to Anna.
example.cn: 他把球抛给了安娜。

example.en: He tossed Anna the ball.
example.cn: 他把球抛给了安娜。

example.en: Our boat was being tossed by the huge waves.
example.cn: 我们的船随着巨浪颠簸。

example.en: There's only one ticket left—I'll toss you for it.
example.cn: 只剩一张票，我来与你掷币决定给谁。

example.en: We tossed up to see who went first.
example.cn: 我们掷硬币决定谁先去。

phrases.filled: toss up between A and B

example.en: He had to toss up between (= decide between) paying the rent or buying food.
example.cn: 他不得不在付房租和买食品之间作出决定。

senses.def: a stupid or unpleasant person
to give yourself sexual pleasure by rubbing your sex organs; to give sb sexual pleasure by rubbing their sex organs
an offensive word for an unpleasant or stupid person
a situation in which either of two choices, results, etc. is equally possible
senses.chn: （两种选择、结果等的）同样可能，均等机会

ex.en: 'Have you decided on the colour yet?' ' It's a toss-up between the blue and the green.'
ex.cn: “你决定了要什么颜色没有？” “在蓝色和绿色之间实在难以取舍。”

senses.def: used when you are giving the first and most important reason for sth

ex.en: To start with it's much too expensive…
ex.cn: 首先是太贵…

senses.def: at the beginning

ex.en: The club had only six members to start with.
ex.cn: 这家俱乐部起初仅有六名会员。

ex.en: I'll have melon to start with.
ex.cn: 我要先吃甜瓜。

ex.en: She wasn't keen on the idea to start with.
ex.cn: 她一开始并不喜欢这个主意。

senses.def: a very young child
a small amount of a strong alcoholic drink in a glass
to add together several numbers or amounts in order to calculate the total
being the amount or number after everyone or everything is counted or added together
senses.chn: 总的；总计的；全体的；全部的

ex.en: the total profit
ex.cn: 利润总额

ex.en: This brought the total number of accidents so far this year to 113.
ex.cn: 这使得今年迄今为止发生事故的总数达到 113 起。

ex.en: The club has a total membership of 300.
ex.cn: 这家俱乐部的成员总数为 300 人。

senses.def: including everything

ex.en: The room was in total darkness.
ex.cn: 房间里一片漆黑。

ex.en: They wanted a total ban on handguns.
ex.cn: 他们要求彻底禁止拥有手枪。

ex.en: The evening was a total disaster.
ex.cn: 晚会彻底搞砸了。

ex.en: I can't believe you'd tell a total stranger about it!
ex.cn: 我不能相信你会把这事告诉一个素昧平生的人！

senses.def: the amount you get when you add several numbers or amounts together; the final number of people or things when they have all been counted

ex.en: You got 47 points on the written examination and 18 on the oral, making a total of 65.
ex.cn: 你笔试得了 47 分，口试得了 18 分，总分 65 分。

ex.en: His businesses are worth a combined total of $3 billion.
ex.cn: 他的企业加在一起总值 30 亿美元。

ex.en: Out of a total of 15 games, they only won 2.
ex.cn: 在总共 15 场比赛中，他们只胜了 2 场。

ex.en: The repairs came to over £500 in total (= including everything).
ex.cn: 修理费总共 500 多英镑。

senses.def: to reach a particular total

ex.en: Imports totalled $1.5 billion last year.
ex.cn: 去年的进口总额达 15 亿美元。

senses.def: to add up the numbers of sth/sb and get a total

ex.en: Each student's points were totalled and entered in a list.
ex.cn: 每个学生的总分都已计算出来并列入表中。

senses.def: to damage a car very badly, so that it is not worth repairing it
in which there is only one political party that has complete power and control over the people
the state of being complete or whole; the whole number or amount
senses.chn: 全体；全部；整个；总数；总额

ex.en: The seriousness of the situation is difficult to appreciate in its totality.
ex.cn: 很难从全局上理解局势的严重性。

senses.def: a device for showing the number and amount of bets put on a race
senses.chn: 赌金数额显示器（用于赛马等）

senses.def: completely

ex.en: They come from totally different cultures.
ex.cn: 他们来自完全不同的文化。

ex.en: I'm still not totally convinced that he knows what he's doing.
ex.cn: 我仍然不完全相信他明白自己在干什么。

ex.en: This behaviour is totally unacceptable.
ex.cn: 这种行为是完全不能接受的。

ex.en: 'She's so cute!' 'Totally!' (= I agree)
ex.cn: “她真是精明过人！” “一点不错！”

ex.en: It's a totally awesome experience.
ex.cn: 这是个棒极了的经历。

senses.def: a system of management that considers that every employee in an organization is responsible for keeping the highest standards in every aspect of the company's work
senses.chn: 全面质量管理，全面品质管理（认为机构中每个雇员都有责任在各方面按最高标准工作的管理体系）

senses.def: in the quantity that is needed to make sth taste the way you prefer

ex.en: Add salt and pepper to taste.
ex.cn: 适量放盐和胡椒粉。

senses.def: a system of betting on horses in which the total amount of money that is bet on each race is divided among the people who bet on the winners
a large bag for carrying things with you
to carry sth, especially sth heavy

ex.en: We arrived, toting our bags and suitcases.
ex.cn: 我们拎着包拖着行李箱到了那里。

senses.def: carrying the thing mentioned

ex.en: gun-toting soldiers
ex.cn: 持枪的士兵

senses.def: an animal or other natural object that is chosen and respected as a special symbol of a community or family, especially among Native Americans; an image of this animal, etc.
senses.chn: （尤指美洲土著的）图腾；图腾形象

senses.def: a tall wooden pole that has symbols and pictures (called totems) carved or painted on it, traditionally made by Native Americans
a range of different levels in an organization, etc.

ex.en: I didn't want to be low man on the totem pole for ever.
ex.cn: 我不想永远当小人物。

senses.def: totally

ex.en: I totes love that song!
ex.cn: 我太喜欢那首歌了！

senses.def: while a musical instrument is being played

ex.en: They performed to the accompaniment of guitars.
ex.cn: 他们在吉他的伴奏下表演。

senses.def: while sth else is happening
senses.chn: 在…发生时；伴随有；同时有

ex.en: She made her speech to the accompaniment of loud laughter.
ex.cn: 她的演讲不断引起哄堂大笑。

senses.def: used to say that sb now has a particular amount less money than they did before

ex.en: After the sale they were £300 to the bad.
ex.cn: 这笔买卖使他们亏损了 300 英镑。

senses.def: affecting you very strongly

ex.en: His threats chilled her to the bone.
ex.cn: 他的威胁使她不寒而栗。

senses.def: showing or proving the opposite

ex.en: Show me some evidence to the contrary (= proving that sth is not true).
ex.cn: 给我看看有什么相反的证据吧。

ex.en: I will expect to see you on Sunday unless I hear anything to the contrary (= that you are not coming).
ex.cn: 我星期天等你，除非你说不来了。

senses.def: so that the whole of a thing or a person is affected

ex.en: She was shaken to the core by the news.
ex.cn: 这消息使她大为震惊。

ex.en: He's a politician to the core (= in all his attitudes and actions).
ex.cn: 他是个十足的政客。

senses.def: exactly

ex.en: It's been three years to the day since we met.
ex.cn: 我们整整三年没见面了。

senses.def: until sb is dead

ex.en: a fight to the death
ex.cn: 战斗到底

senses.def: to the greatest possible degree

ex.en: I've always believed in living life to the full.
ex.cn: 我总是相信生活要尽量充实。

senses.def: completely full

ex.en: I was stuffed to the gills with chocolate cake.
ex.cn: 我吃巧克力蛋糕都撑到嗓子眼儿了。

senses.def: used to say that sb now has a particular amount of money that they did not have before

ex.en: We are £500 to the good.
ex.cn: 我们净赚 500 英镑。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is true of all the people being described

ex.en: They answered 'Yes,' to a man.
ex.cn: 他们异口同声地回答：“是。”

ex.en: They were all destroyed, to the last man.
ex.cn: 他们无一例外全部被歼。

senses.def: doing/following exactly what sb/sth says, paying attention to every detail
senses.chn: 丝毫不差；不折不扣；精确地

ex.en: I followed your instructions to the letter.
ex.cn: 我是严格遵照你的指示办的。

senses.def: to the highest level or greatest amount possible
senses.chn: 最高程度地；最大数量地

ex.en: She believes in living life to the max.
ex.cn: 她认为人应当尽量活得充实。

senses.def: intended to show respect and remind people of sb who has died

ex.en: He founded the charity in memory of his late wife.
ex.cn: 他创办了这一慈善事业以纪念他已故的妻子。

senses.def: exactly

ex.en: The train arrived at 9.05 to the minute.
ex.cn: 列车 9:05 准时到达。

senses.def: extremely; to an extreme degree
senses.chn: 极端地；非常地；极大程度上

senses.def: expressed in a simple, clear way without any extra information or feelings

ex.en: The letter was short and to the point.
ex.cn: 这封信简短扼要。

senses.def: the other

ex.en: I saw it t'other day.
ex.cn: 几天前我见过它。

ex.en: They were talking of this, that and t'other.
ex.cn: 他们谈这，谈那，无所不谈。

senses.def: used to emphasize how much money sth has cost

ex.en: The hotel has been refurbished to the tune of a million dollars.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆重新装修花费达一百万美元。

senses.def: even now, when a lot of time has passed

ex.en: To this day, I still don't understand why he did it.
ex.cn: 我直到今天仍然不明白他当时为什么那样做。

senses.def: to walk or move with weak unsteady steps, especially because you are drunk or ill/sick
to be weak and seem likely to fall

ex.en: the tottering walls of the castle
ex.cn: 城堡摇摇欲坠的墙壁

ex.en: a tottering dictatorship
ex.cn: 濒临瓦解的独裁统治

senses.def: sexually attractive women (an expression used by men, and usually offensive to women)
a tropical American bird that is black with some areas of very bright feathers, and that has a very large beak
senses.chn: 鵎鵼，巨嘴鸟（分布于美洲热带地区，羽毛鲜艳，喙很大）

senses.def: to put your hand or another part of your body onto sb/sth

ex.en: Don't touch that plate—it's hot!
ex.cn: 别碰那个盘子，烫手！

ex.en: Can you touch your toes?(= bend and reach them with your hands)
ex.cn: 你直腿弯腰够得着你的脚趾吗？

ex.en: I touched him lightly on the arm.
ex.cn: 我轻轻碰了碰他的手臂。

ex.en: He has hardly touched the ball all game.
ex.cn: 他整场比赛几乎没碰到过球。

ex.en: I must do some more work on that article—I haven't touched it all week.
ex.cn: 我还得在那篇文章上再下点儿功夫，我整整一个星期没有碰它了。

senses.def: to be or come so close together that there is no space between

ex.en: Make sure the wires don't touch.
ex.cn: 一定不要让金属线搭在一起。

ex.en: Don't let your coat touch the wet paint.
ex.cn: 你的外衣别蹭着还没有干的油漆。

ex.en: His coat was so long it was almost touching the floor.
ex.cn: 他的大衣太长，差不多拖到地板上了。

senses.def: to move sth, especially in such a way that you damage it; to hit or harm sb

ex.en: I told you not to touch my things.
ex.cn: 我告诉过你不要动我的东西。

ex.en: He said I kicked him, but I never touched him!
ex.cn: 他说我踢他了，可是我从来就没碰过他！

senses.def: to make sb feel upset or sympathetic

ex.en: Her story touched us all deeply.
ex.cn: 她的故事使我们大家深受感动。

senses.def: to affect or concern sb/sth

ex.en: These are issues that touch us all.
ex.cn: 这些问题与我们大家都有关系。

senses.def: to eat, drink or use sth

ex.en: You've hardly touched your food.
ex.cn: 你没怎么吃东西啊。

ex.en: He hasn't touched the money his aunt left him.
ex.cn: 他还没动过他姑妈留给他的钱。

senses.def: to be as good as sb in skill, quality, etc.

ex.en: No one can touch him when it comes to interior design.
ex.cn: 在室内设计方面，没有人能比得上他。

senses.def: to reach a particular level, etc.

ex.en: The speedometer was touching 90.
ex.cn: 速度表显示时速达 90 英里。

senses.def: to become connected with or work with a situation or person

ex.en: Everything she touches turns to disaster.
ex.cn: 什么事她一插手就会糟糕。

ex.en: His last two movies have been complete flops and now no studio will touch him.
ex.cn: 他的前两部电影彻底失败了，现在没有制片厂愿意用他。

senses.def: to be seen on sb's face for a short time

ex.en: A smile touched the corners of his mouth.
ex.cn: 他的嘴角闪现出一丝笑意。

senses.def: to have a small amount of a particular quality

ex.en: His hair was touched with grey.
ex.cn: 他的头发有些斑白。

senses.def: to refuse to get involved with sb/sth or in a particular situation
senses.chn: 决不与…有任何牵扯；拒不牵扯到…中去

senses.def: to make contact with sb again
to reach the ground at the bottom of an area of water
to reach the worst possible state or condition
senses.chn: 到最坏境况；到最低点；跌到谷底

senses.def: used when you have just mentioned some way in which you have been lucky in the past, to avoid bringing bad luck

ex.en: I've been driving for over 20 years and never had an accident—touch wood!
ex.cn: 我开车 20 多年从来没出过车祸，但愿好运常在！

senses.def: to say or do sth that makes people feel sympathy or enthusiasm

ex.en: The speaker had obviously struck a chord with his audience.
ex.cn: 讲演者显然已引起了听众的共鸣。

senses.def: to show too much respect for sb, especially because you are anxious about what they think of you
to not hurt sb physically in any way
senses.chn: 不动某人一根头发；丝毫不伤害某人

senses.def: to mention a subject that makes sb feel angry, upset, embarrassed, etc.

ex.en: You touched a raw nerve when you mentioned his first wife.
ex.cn: 你谈起他的第一任妻子，这就触到了他的痛处。

senses.def: to upset sb by reminding them of sth they are particularly sensitive about
senses.chn: 触到某人的痛处；揭某人的疮疤

senses.def: to make contact with the ground as it lands

ex.en: Tornadoes touched down in Alabama and Louisiana.
ex.cn: 龙卷风在亚拉巴马州和路易斯安那州登陆了。

senses.def: to score a try by putting the ball on the ground behind the other team's goal line
senses.chn: （在对方球门线后）持球触地得分；达阵

senses.def: to persuade sb to give or lend you sth, especially money
to make sth begin, especially a difficult or violent situation
senses.chn: 触发，引发，引起（困难或暴力的局面）

senses.def: to mention or deal with a subject in only a few words, without going into detail

ex.en: In his speech he was only able to touch on a few aspects of the problem.
ex.cn: 他在演讲中只能涉及这个问题的几个方面。

senses.def: to touch sb sexually, usually in a way that is not expected or welcome
to improve sth by changing or adding to it slightly

ex.en: She was busy touching up her make-up in the mirror.
ex.cn: 她正忙着对着镜子补妆。

senses.def: the sense that enables you to be aware of things and what they are like when you put your hands and fingers on them

ex.en: the sense of touch
ex.cn: 触觉

senses.def: an act of putting your hand or another part of your body onto sb/sth

ex.en: The gentle touch of his hand on her shoulder made her jump.
ex.cn: 他的手轻轻地触了一下她肩膀便使她跳了起来。

ex.en: All this information is readily available at the touch of a button (= by simply pressing a button).
ex.cn: 这么多的资料，按下按钮便可毫不费力地查到。

ex.en: This type of engraving requires a delicate touch.
ex.cn: 这种雕刻要求手法轻巧。

senses.def: the way that sth feels when you put your hand or fingers on it or when it comes into contact with your body

ex.en: The body was cold to the touch.
ex.cn: 这具尸体摸上去是冰冷的。

ex.en: material with a smooth silky touch
ex.cn: 摸起来光滑得像丝绸一样的料子

ex.en: He could not bear the touch of clothing on his sunburnt skin.
ex.cn: 他忍受不住衣服磨蹭他那被太阳灼伤的皮肤。

senses.def: a small detail that is added to sth in order to improve it or make it complete

ex.en: I spent the morning putting the finishing touches to the report.
ex.cn: 我花了一个上午为这个报告做最后的润色。

ex.en: Meeting them at the airport was a nice touch.
ex.cn: 到机场迎接他们是一个妙招。

senses.def: a way or style of doing sth

ex.en: She prefers to answer any fan mail herself for a more personal touch.
ex.cn: 她喜欢针对每一位崇拜者的来信，亲自予以回复。

ex.en: Computer graphics will give your presentation the professional touch.
ex.cn: 计算机绘图将会使你的演示具有专业特色。

ex.en: He couldn't find his magic touch with the ball today (= he didn't play well).
ex.cn: 他今天施展不出神奇的球技。

ex.en: This meal is awful. I think I'm losing my touch (= my ability to do sth).
ex.cn: 这顿饭太难吃了。我想我的烹调技艺在走下坡路。

senses.def: a very small amount

ex.en: There was a touch of sarcasm in her voice.
ex.cn: 她的话音中有点儿讥讽的意味。

senses.def: slightly; a little

ex.en: The music was a touch too loud for my liking.
ex.cn: 这音乐有点太吵，不合我的口味。

senses.def: the area outside the lines that mark the sides of the playing field

ex.en: He kicked the ball into touch.
ex.cn: 他把球踢出了边线。

senses.def: to communicate with sb, especially by writing to them or telephoning them

ex.en: Are you still in touch with your friends from college?
ex.cn: 你和大学的同学还有联系吗？

ex.en: Thanks for showing us your products—we'll be in touch.
ex.cn: 谢谢给我们介绍你们的产品，我们将会保持联系。

ex.en: I'm trying to get in touch with Jane. Do you have her number?
ex.cn: 我正在设法和简取得联系。你有她的电话号码吗？

ex.en: Let's keep in touch.
ex.cn: 咱们保持联系。

ex.en: I'll put you in touch with someone in your area.
ex.cn: 我将安排你和你那个地区的一个人进行联系。

senses.def: to know what is happening in a particular subject or area
senses.chn: 了解（某课题或领域的情况）

ex.en: It is important to keep in touch with the latest research.
ex.cn: 及时了解最新研究情况很重要。

senses.def: to no longer communicate with sb, so that you no longer know what is happening to them
senses.chn: 失去联系；不再了解（某人的）情况

senses.def: to not know or understand what is happening in a particular subject or area
senses.chn: 不再了解，不懂得（某课题或领域）的情况

ex.en: Unfortunately, the people making the decisions are out of touch with the real world.
ex.cn: 令人遗憾的是，制定决策的人不了解实情。

senses.def: a person that you can easily persuade to do sth, especially to give you money
senses.chn: （尤指在钱财方面）有求必应的人，耳根子软的人

ex.en: Unfortunately, my father is no soft touch.
ex.cn: 可惜，我父亲并非有求必应。

senses.def: to no longer have any contact with sb/sth

ex.en: I've lost touch with all my old friends.
ex.cn: 我与所有的老朋友都失去了联系。

senses.def: to no longer understand sth, especially how ordinary people feel
senses.chn: 不再了解（尤指一般人的想法）

senses.def: the ability of a powerful or famous person to talk to and understand ordinary people
senses.chn: （有权势者或名人的）平易近人的品质，亲民作风

senses.def: to reject, remove or stop dealing with a problem

ex.en: He tends to deal with disputes by kicking them into the long grass.
ex.cn: 他处理争议的方法往往是置之不理。

senses.def: the ability to deal with sth in a delicate and relaxed way

ex.en: She handles this difficult subject with a light touch.
ex.cn: 她处理起这个难题来得心应手。

example.en: Don't let your coat touch the wet paint.
example.cn: 你的外衣别蹭着还没有干的油漆。

senses.def: used to say that the result of a situation is uncertain and that there is a possibility that sth bad or unpleasant will happen
senses.chn: 不确定；无把握；很难说；吉凶未卜

ex.en: She's fine now, but it was touch-and-go for a while (= there was a possibility that she might die).
ex.cn: 她现在好了，可是她曾一度病危。

senses.def: to reach the ground at the bottom of an area of water
to reach the worst possible state or condition
senses.chn: 到最坏境况；到最低点；跌到谷底

senses.def: to make contact with the ground as it lands

ex.en: Tornadoes touched down in Alabama and Louisiana.
ex.cn: 龙卷风在亚拉巴马州和路易斯安那州登陆了。

senses.def: to score a try by putting the ball on the ground behind the other team's goal line
senses.chn: （在对方球门线后）持球触地得分；达阵

senses.def: the moment when a plane or spacecraft lands
senses.chn: （飞机或航天器的）着陆，降落，接地

senses.def: an act of scoring points by putting the ball down on the area of ground behind the other team's goal line
senses.chn: （在对方球门线后）持球触地；达阵

senses.def: an act of scoring points by crossing the other team's goal line while carrying the ball, or receiving the ball when you are over the other team's goal line
