visiting restaurants, clubs, theatres, etc. for entertainment, especially at night

ex.en: a night on the town
ex.cn: 去娱乐场所作乐的夜晚

ex.en: How about going out on the town tonight?
ex.cn: 今晚出去痛痛快快地玩一玩怎么样？

senses.def: the most important thing of a particular type, or the only thing that is available
senses.chn: 同类中最重要的事物；唯一的选择

senses.def: a man who frequently goes to fashionable parties, clubs, theatres, etc.
senses.chn: 喜欢社交者；社交界名人

senses.def: to go to a lot of different bars, clubs, etc. and enjoy yourself
senses.chn: 花天酒地地玩乐；出没于各娱乐场所

senses.def: the relationship between the people who live permanently in a town where there is a university and the members of the university
senses.chn: 大学城居民与师生的关系

senses.def: the main part of a town, where the shops/stores are
senses.chn: 市中心；（城镇的）商业中心

senses.def: a public officer in charge of the records of a town
in the past, the person who was the secretary of, and gave legal advice to, the local government of a town
senses.chn: （旧时的）镇政府秘书兼法律顾问

senses.def: (in the past) a person whose job was to walk through a town shouting news, official announcements, etc.
senses.chn: （旧时沿街高声传报消息等的）街头公告员

senses.def: a building containing local government offices and, in Britain, usually a hall for public meetings, concerts, etc.
senses.chn: 镇公所；市政厅；（英国）市镇集会所

senses.def: a house in a town owned by sb who also has a house in the country
senses.chn: （另有乡村住房者的）城市住宅

senses.def: a tall narrow house in a town that is part of a row of similar houses

ex.en: an elegant Georgian town house
ex.cn: 一套具有乔治王朝时期风格的典雅排房

senses.def: a person who lives in or comes from a town or city, especially sb who does not know much about life in the countryside
senses.chn: （尤指不了解乡村生活的）城里人

senses.def: a person who lives in a town with a college or university but does not attend or work at it
senses.chn: （大学城中不上大学或不在大学工作的）居民，老百姓

senses.def: a member of a group of young people who live in a town, all wear similar clothes, such as tracksuits and caps, and often behave badly
senses.chn: 阿飞，城市小流氓（穿着类似，行为不端）

senses.def: a meeting when people in a town come together to discuss problems that affect the town and to give their opinions on various issues
the control of the development of towns and their buildings, roads, etc. so that they can be pleasant and convenient places for people to live in; the subject that studies this
what you see when you look at a town, for example from a distance

ex.en: an industrial townscape
ex.cn: 工业城市景象

senses.def: a picture of a town
(in South Africa in the past) a town or part of a town that black people had to live in, and where only black people lived
senses.chn: （旧时南非的）黑人城镇，黑人居住区

senses.def: (in the US or Canada) a division of a county that is a unit of local government
senses.chn: 镇区（美国和加拿大县以下一级的地方政府）

senses.def: people who live in towns, not in the countryside; the people who live in a particular town
senses.chn: 镇民；市民；城里人；（某一城镇的）居民

senses.def: an industrial port and resort on the coast of Queensland, north-eastern Australia
senses.chn: 汤斯维尔（澳大利亚东北部昆士兰州沿海工业港口和旅游胜地）

senses.def: a path along the bank of a river or canal, that was used in the past by horses pulling boats (called barges)
senses.chn: 纤道，纤路（旧时河流沿岸马拉驳船所走的路）

senses.def: a rope that is used for pulling sth along, especially a vehicle
a truck that is used for taking cars away to be repaired when they have had a breakdown
senses.chn: （把故障车辆拖去修理的）牵引车，救险车

senses.def: infection of the blood by harmful bacteria
containing poison; poisonous

ex.en: toxic chemicals/fumes/gases/substances
ex.cn: 有毒的化学品／烟雾／气体／物质

ex.en: to dispose of toxic waste
ex.cn: 处理有毒废料

ex.en: Many pesticides are highly toxic.
ex.cn: 许多杀虫剂毒性很大。

senses.def: a level of debt or high-risk investment that causes very serious problems for a bank or other financial institution
senses.chn: 有毒的（指能引致银行或其他金融机构出现严重问题的高水平债务或高风险投资）

senses.def: having a very unpleasant personality, especially in the way they like to control and influence other people in a dishonest way
senses.chn: 卑鄙无耻的；（尤指）爱摆布人的

senses.def: the quality of being poisonous; the extent to which sth is poisonous

ex.en: substances with high levels of toxicity
ex.cn: 毒性大的物质

senses.def: the effect that a poisonous substance has

ex.en: Minor toxicities of this drug include nausea and vomiting.
ex.cn: 这种药的轻微毒性反应包括恶心和呕吐。

senses.def: the scientific study of poisons
a serious illness in women caused by harmful bacteria in the vagina, connected with the use of tampons
a poisonous substance, especially one that is produced by bacteria in plants and animals
senses.chn: 毒素（尤指生物体内细菌产生的毒物）

senses.def: a disease that can be dangerous to a baby while it is still in its mother's body, caught from infected meat, soil, or animal faeces
senses.chn: 弓形体病，弓形虫病（对胎儿有害，由感染病菌的肉、土壤或动物粪便传染）

senses.def: an object for children to play with

ex.en: cuddly/soft toys
ex.cn: 毛绒玩具

ex.en: The children were playing happily with their toys.
ex.cn: 孩子们正高兴地玩着玩具。

senses.def: an object that you have for enjoyment or pleasure rather than for a serious purpose

ex.en: executive toys
ex.cn: 行政人员的玩意儿

ex.en: His latest toy is the electric drill he bought last week.
ex.cn: 他的新玩意儿是他上星期买的电钻。

senses.def: made as a copy of a particular thing and used for playing with

ex.en: a toy car
ex.cn: 玩具汽车

ex.en: toy soldiers
ex.cn: 玩具士兵

senses.def: of a very small breed
senses.chn: 个头很小的；小体型品种的

ex.en: a toy poodle
ex.cn: 小鬈毛狗

senses.def: to consider an idea or a plan, but not very seriously and not for a long time
senses.chn: 不太认真地考虑；把…当儿戏

ex.en: I did briefly toy with the idea of living in France.
ex.cn: 我确实闪过定居法国的念头。

senses.def: to play with sth and move it around carelessly or without thinking

ex.en: He kept toying nervously with his pen.
ex.cn: 他一直精神紧张地摆弄着钢笔。

ex.en: She hardly ate a thing, just toyed with a piece of cheese on her plate.
ex.cn: 她几乎没吃一点东西，只是拨弄着碟子里的一块奶酪。

senses.def: a woman's male lover who is much younger than she is
senses.chn: （比情妇年轻得多的）小情夫，小男友

senses.def: a type of dance or march, used as a form of protest, in which you repeatedly move one leg up and down followed by the other
senses.chn: 托弋托弋舞（或游行）（作为抗议示威，左右交替踢腿）

senses.def: in every way

ex.en: She's a perfectionist to her fingertips.
ex.cn: 她是个道道地地的完美主义者。

senses.def: as much as you want

ex.en: a supervised play area where children can run around to their heart's content
ex.cn: 一处能让孩子们尽情游玩且有人看管的地方

senses.def: from the information you have, although you may not know everything

ex.en: 'Are they divorced?' 'Not to my knowledge.'
ex.cn: “他们离婚了吗？” “据我所知没有。”

senses.def: to consider an idea or a plan, but not very seriously and not for a long time
senses.chn: 不太认真地考虑；把…当儿戏

ex.en: I did briefly toy with the idea of living in France.
ex.cn: 我确实闪过定居法国的念头。

senses.def: to play with sth and move it around carelessly or without thinking

ex.en: He kept toying nervously with his pen.
ex.cn: 他一直精神紧张地摆弄着钢笔。

ex.en: She hardly ate a thing, just toyed with a piece of cheese on her plate.
ex.cn: 她几乎没吃一点东西，只是拨弄着碟子里的一块奶酪。

senses.def: total quality management
senses.chn: 全面质量管理；全面品质管理

senses.def: to find or discover sb/sth by looking carefully for them/it

ex.en: We finally traced him to an address in Chicago.
ex.cn: 我们终于追查到他在芝加哥的一个地址。

senses.def: to find the origin or cause of sth

ex.en: She could trace her family tree back to the 16th century.
ex.cn: 她能把本族家谱追溯到 16 世纪。

ex.en: The leak was eventually traced to a broken seal.
ex.cn: 最后查出泄漏是由于密封处破裂所致。

ex.en: The police traced the call (= used special electronic equipment to find out who made the telephone call) to her ex-husband's number.
ex.cn: 警方用追踪装置查出是她前夫的电话号码打出的电话。

senses.def: to describe a process or the development of sth
senses.chn: 描绘（事物的过程或发展）；追述；记述

ex.en: Her book traces the town's history from Saxon times to the present day.
ex.cn: 她的书描述的是这个市镇从撒克逊时代到现在的历史。

senses.def: to draw a line or lines on a surface

ex.en: She traced a line in the sand.
ex.cn: 她在沙地上画了一条线。

senses.def: to follow the shape or outline of sth

ex.en: He traced the route on the map.
ex.cn: 他在地图上勾画出了路线。

ex.en: A tear traced a path down her cheek.
ex.cn: 一滴眼泪沿着她的面颊流了下来。

senses.def: to copy a map, drawing, etc. by drawing on transparent paper (= tracing paper ) placed over it
senses.chn: （用透明纸覆盖在地图、绘画等上）复制，描摹

senses.def: a mark, an object or a sign that shows that sb/sth existed or was present

ex.en: It's exciting to discover traces of earlier civilizations.
ex.cn: 发现早期文明的遗迹，真令人兴奋。

ex.en: Police searched the area but found no trace of the escaped prisoners.
ex.cn: 警方搜索了那一地区，但未发现越狱逃犯的任何踪迹。

ex.en: Years of living in England had eliminated all trace of her American accent.
ex.cn: 她多年居住在英国，美国口音已荡然无存。

ex.en: The ship had vanished without (a) trace.
ex.cn: 那艘船消失得无影无踪。

senses.def: a very small amount of sth

ex.en: The post-mortem revealed traces of poison in his stomach.
ex.cn: 验尸发现他胃中有微量毒物。

ex.en: She spoke without a trace of bitterness.
ex.cn: 她说话时一点儿也不伤感。

senses.def: a line or pattern on paper or a screen that shows information that is found by a machine
senses.chn: 描记图；轨迹；迹线；扫描线

ex.en: The trace showed a normal heart rhythm.
ex.cn: 描记图显示心率正常。

senses.def: a search to find out information about the identity of sb/sth, especially what number a telephone call was made from

ex.en: The police ran a trace on the call.
ex.cn: 警察对那次通话进行了追踪。

senses.def: one of the two long pieces of leather that fasten a carriage or cart to the horse that pulls it
to start to behave badly and refuse to accept any discipline or control
senses.chn: （开始）不听话，不守规矩，不受管束

senses.def: if sth is traceable, you can find out where it came from, where it has gone, when it began or what its cause was
senses.chn: 可追溯的；可追踪的；可追本溯源的

ex.en: Most telephone calls are traceable.
ex.cn: 大多数电话都可查出是从哪里打来的。

senses.def: a chemical substance that is found in very small amounts
a chemical substance that living things, especially plants, need only in very small amounts to be able to grow well
senses.chn: 微量元素（生物，尤指植物，生长所需要的微量的化学物质）

senses.def: a bullet or shell (= a kind of bomb) that leaves a line of smoke or flame behind it
a radioactive substance that can be seen in the human body and is used to find out what is happening inside the body
a pattern of lines and curves in stone on the top part of some church windows
senses.chn: 花色窗棂，窗花格（某些教堂窗户顶部的石制花饰）

senses.def: an attractive pattern of lines and curves
a person who takes part in the sport of parkour
the tube in the throat that carries air to the lungs
a medical operation to cut a hole in sb's trachea so that they can breathe
a copy of a map, drawing, etc. that you make by drawing on a piece of transparent paper placed on top of it
strong transparent paper that is placed on top of a drawing, etc. so that you can follow the lines with a pen or pencil in order to make a copy of it
a rough path or road, usually one that has not been built but that has been made by people walking there

ex.en: a muddy track through the forest
ex.cn: 穿过森林的泥泞小径

senses.def: marks left by a person, an animal or a moving vehicle
senses.chn: （人、动物或车辆留下的）足迹，踪迹；车辙

ex.en: We followed the bear's tracks in the snow.
ex.cn: 我们跟着熊在雪地上留下的足迹走。

ex.en: tyre tracks
ex.cn: 轮胎印迹

senses.def: rails that a train moves along

ex.en: railway/railroad tracks
ex.cn: 铁路轨道

ex.en: India has thousands of miles of track.
ex.cn: 印度有数千英里的铁道。

senses.def: a track with a number at a train station that a train arrives at or leaves from

ex.en: The train for Chicago is on track 9.
ex.cn: 开往芝加哥的列车停靠在 9 号站台。

ex.en: The Edinburgh train is waiting at platform 4.
ex.cn: 去爱丁堡的火车在 4 号站台等候。

ex.en: The train for Chicago is on track 9.
ex.cn: 开往芝加哥的列车停靠在 9 号站台。

senses.def: a piece of ground with a special surface for people, cars, etc. to have races on

ex.en: a running track
ex.cn: 赛跑跑道

ex.en: a Formula One Grand Prix track (= for motor racing)
ex.cn: 一级方程式大奖赛赛道

senses.def: the path or direction that sb/sth is moving in

ex.en: Police are on the track of (= searching for) the thieves.
ex.cn: 警察正在追踪窃贼。

ex.en: She is on the fast track to promotion (= will get it quickly).
ex.cn: 她现在升迁在望。

senses.def: a piece of music or song on a record, tape or CD
senses.chn: （唱片、录音磁带或光盘的）一首乐曲，一首歌曲

ex.en: a track from their latest album
ex.cn: 他们最新唱片专辑里的一首歌曲

senses.def: part of a tape, CD or computer disk that music or information can be recorded on
senses.chn: （录音磁带、光盘或计算机磁盘的）音轨，声道

ex.en: a sixteen track recording studio
ex.cn: 十六声道录音室

ex.en: She sang on the backing track.
ex.cn: 她是唱和声的。

senses.def: a pole or rail that a curtain moves along
a continuous belt of metal plates around the wheels of a large vehicle such as a bulldozer that allows it to move over the ground
going in the right direction again after a mistake, failure, etc.
senses.chn: 重新步入正确轨道；恢复正常

ex.en: I tried to get my life back on track after my divorce.
ex.cn: 离婚之后我力图使生活恢复正常。

senses.def: to be doing the right thing in order to achieve a particular result

ex.en: Curtis is on track for the gold medal.
ex.cn: 柯蒂斯正踏上夺取金牌之途。

senses.def: to have/not have information about what is happening or where sb/sth is
senses.chn: 了解／不了解…的动态；与…保持／失去联系

ex.en: Bank statements help you keep track of where your money is going.
ex.cn: 银行账单有助于你了解你的资金使用情况。

ex.en: I lost all track of time (= forgot what time it was).
ex.cn: 我完全忘了时间。

senses.def: to leave a place, especially to go home
thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
senses.chn: 思路对头／不对头；做法对路／不对路

senses.def: to suddenly make sb stop by frightening or surprising them; to suddenly stop because sth has frightened or surprised you
senses.chn: （使由于恐惧或吃惊）突然止步；（使）怔住

ex.en: The question stopped Alice in her tracks.
ex.cn: 这个问题问得艾丽斯张口结舌无以答对。

senses.def: far away from other people, houses, etc.

ex.en: They live miles off the beaten track.
ex.cn: 他们住在偏远地带。

senses.def: to try and hide what you have done, because you do not want other people to find out about it

ex.en: He had attempted to cover his tracks by making her death appear like suicide.
ex.cn: 他使她的死亡看起来像是自杀，企图以此掩盖自己的罪行。

senses.def: close to catching or finding the person or thing that you have been chasing or searching for
senses.chn: 快要抓到，即将找到（某人或物）

senses.def: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.chn: 来自（城里的）贫民区；住在贫穷的地区（或城区）

senses.def: to find sb/sth by following the marks, signs, information, etc., that they have left behind them

ex.en: hunters tracking and shooting bears
ex.cn: 追踪射猎熊的猎人

senses.def: to follow the movements of sb/sth, especially by using special electronic equipment
senses.chn: （尤指用特殊电子设备）跟踪，追踪

ex.en: We continued tracking the plane on our radar.
ex.cn: 我们继续用雷达追踪那架飞机。

senses.def: to follow the progress or development of sb/sth

ex.en: The research project involves tracking the careers of 400 graduates.
ex.cn: 这个研究项目对 400 名毕业生的事业发展情况进行跟踪调查。

senses.def: to move in relation to the thing that is being filmed

ex.en: The camera eventually tracked away.
ex.cn: 摄影机最终将镜头推远。

senses.def: to leave dirty marks behind you as you walk

ex.en: Don't track mud on my clean floor.
ex.cn: 别在我干净的地板上踩上泥脚印。

senses.def: to find sb/sth after searching in several different places
senses.chn: 搜寻到；跟踪找到；追查到

ex.en: The police have so far failed to track down the attacker.
ex.cn: 警方至今未能追捕到攻击者。

senses.def: sports that people compete in, such as running and jumping
a device containing a ball that is used instead of a mouse to move the cursor around the screen
senses.chn: 跟踪球；光标运动球；轨迹球

senses.def: a person who can find people or wild animals by following the marks that they leave on the ground
senses.chn: 追踪者；跟踪者；追踪人（或野兽）的人

senses.def: a dog that has been trained to help the police find people or explosives
senses.chn: （受过训练协助搜寻人或炸药的）警犬，搜救犬

senses.def: a sports event that is a race run on a track, rather than jumping or throwing sth
a place where people follow the movements of aircraft, etc. in the sky by radar or radio
senses.chn: （用雷达或无线电追踪飞机等动向的）跟踪站

senses.def: a bus driven by electricity from a cable above the street
all the past achievements, successes or failures of a person or an organization

ex.en: He has a proven track record in marketing.
ex.cn: 他有可靠的营销业绩记录。

senses.def: a warm loose pair of trousers/pants and matching jacket worn for sports practice or as informal clothes
senses.chn: （运动练习时或作便衣穿的）宽松暖和的衣裤；运动服

senses.def: a system of connected organs or tissues along which materials or messages pass
senses.chn: （连通身体组织或器官的）道，束

ex.en: the digestive tract
ex.cn: 消化道

ex.en: a nerve tract
ex.cn: 神经束

senses.def: an area of land, especially a large one

ex.en: vast tracts of forest
ex.cn: 大片大片的森林

senses.def: a short piece of writing, especially on a religious, moral or political subject, that is intended to influence people's ideas
senses.chn: （尤指宣扬宗教、伦理或政治的）短文，传单，小册子

senses.def: easy to deal with or control
a modern house built on an area of land where a lot of other similar houses have also been built
the action of pulling sth along a surface; the power that is used for doing this
a way of treating a broken bone in your body that involves using special equipment to pull the bone gradually back into its correct place
senses.chn: 牵引（使体内断骨复位的疗法）

ex.en: He spent six weeks in traction after he broke his leg.
ex.cn: 他腿部骨折后做了六个星期的牵引治疗。

senses.def: the force that stops sth, for example the wheels of a vehicle, from sliding on the ground
senses.chn: （车轮等对地面的）附着摩擦力

senses.def: a vehicle, driven by steam or diesel oil, used in the past for pulling heavy loads
senses.chn: （旧时用以拖重物的）牵引机车，牵引车

senses.def: a powerful vehicle with two large and two smaller wheels, used especially for pulling farm machinery
the front part of a tractor-trailer, where the driver sits
senses.chn: （牵引式挂车的）牵引车，拖车头

senses.def: a large lorry/truck with two sections, one in front where the driver sits and one behind for carrying goods. The sections are connected by a flexible joint so that the tractor-trailer can turn corners more easily.
senses.chn: 牵引式挂车；铰接式卡车；载重拖车

senses.def: traditional jazz in the style of the 1920s, with free playing (= improvisation) against a background of fixed rhythms and combinations of notes
senses.chn: 传统爵士乐（有 20 世纪 20 年代的风格、固定的节奏及和声，可即兴发挥）

senses.def: that you can easily buy and sell or exchange for money or goods
the activity of buying and selling or of exchanging goods or services between people or countries

ex.en: international/foreign trade
ex.cn: 国际／对外贸易

ex.en: Trade between the two countries has increased.
ex.cn: 两国之间的贸易增长了。

ex.en: the international trade in oil
ex.cn: 国际石油贸易

ex.en: the arms/drugs, etc. trade
ex.cn: 军火、毒品等交易

senses.def: a particular type of business

ex.en: the building/food/tourist, etc. trade
ex.cn: 建筑业、食品业、旅游业等

ex.en: He works in the retail trade (= selling goods in shops/stores).

senses.def: to start to come in or go out

ex.en: The tide is turning—we'd better get back.
ex.cn: 涨潮了，我们最好回去吧。

senses.def: to make or let sb/sth go into a particular place or state

ex.en: They turned the horse into the field.
ex.cn: 他们把马松开放到牧场里。

ex.en: to turn the dogs loose
ex.cn: 把狗放开

senses.def: to fold sth in a particular way

ex.en: She turned down the blankets and climbed into bed.
ex.cn: 她掀开毯子爬上床去。

ex.en: He turned up the collar of his coat and hurried out into the rain.
ex.cn: 他竖起大衣领子，冒雨匆匆走了。

senses.def: to perform a movement by moving your body in a circle

ex.en: to turn cartwheels/somersaults
ex.cn: 做侧手翻；翻筋斗

senses.def: if you turn a page of a book or magazine, you move it so that you can read the next page

ex.en: He sat turning the pages idly.
ex.cn: 他坐在那里无所事事地翻着书。

ex.en: Turn to p.23.
ex.cn: 翻到第 23 页。

senses.def: if a game turns or sb turns it, it changes the way it is developing so that a different person or team starts to win
to change into a particular state or condition; to make sth do this

ex.en: The leaves were turning brown.
ex.cn: 叶子变黄。

ex.en: The weather has turned cold.
ex.cn: 天气变得寒冷了。

ex.en: He turned nasty when we refused to give him the money.
ex.cn: 我们不给他钱，他变得穷凶极恶。

ex.en: He decided to turn professional.
ex.cn: 他决定转为职业人员。

ex.en: The heat turned the milk sour.
ex.cn: 炎热的天气使得牛奶变酸了。

ex.en: She turned a deathly shade of white when she heard the news.
ex.cn: 她听到这个消息时面如死灰。

senses.def: to reach or pass a particular age or time
senses.chn: 到达，超过（某一年龄或时间）

ex.en: She turns 21 in June.
ex.cn: 她到六月份就满 21 岁了。

ex.en: It's turned midnight.
ex.cn: 已过了午夜。

senses.def: when your stomach turns or sth turns your stomach, you feel as though you will vomit
to shape sth on a lathe

ex.en: to turn a chair leg
ex.cn: 在车床上车椅子腿

ex.en: turned boxes and bowls
ex.cn: 车削成的盒和碗

senses.def: as was shown or proved by later events
senses.chn: 正如后来表明的；果然如此；果不其然

ex.en: I didn't need my umbrella, as it turned out (= because it didn't rain).
ex.cn: 我果然没用上我的伞。

senses.def: to be well, badly, etc. dressed
senses.chn: 穿着打扮得好（或不好等）

senses.def: used to report what sb says or does, when this is surprising or annoying
senses.chn: （用以报告令人吃惊或不快的言行）竟会

ex.en: How could she turn round and say that, after all I've done for her?
ex.cn: 我为她做了这么多，她怎么竟会说出那种话来？

senses.def: to stop or make sb stop being friendly towards sb

ex.en: She turned against her old friend.
ex.cn: 她与老朋友翻脸了。

ex.en: After the divorce he tried to turn the children against their mother.
ex.cn: 他离婚后企图教唆子女反对他们的母亲。

senses.def: to change position or direction so as to face the other way; to make sb/sth do this

ex.en: Turn around and let me look at your back.
ex.cn: 转过身去让我看看你的后背。

ex.en: I turned my chair round to face the fire.
ex.cn: 我把椅子转过来面向火炉。

senses.def: if a business, economy, etc. turns around or sb turns it around, it starts being successful after it has been unsuccessful for a time
senses.chn: （使企业、经济等）好转，扭转，有起色

senses.def: to refuse to allow sb to enter a place
senses.chn: 把某人拒之门外；不准某人进入

ex.en: Hundreds of people were turned away from the stadium (= because it was full).
ex.cn: 体育场满座，数百人被拒之门外。

ex.en: They had nowhere to stay so I couldn't turn them away.
ex.cn: 他们无处安身，所以我不能把他们打发走。

senses.def: to return the way you have come; to make sb/sth do this

ex.en: The weather became so bad that they had to turn back.
ex.cn: 天气变得非常恶劣，他们不得不循原路折回。

ex.en: We said we would do it—there can be no turning back.
ex.cn: 我们说过要干这事，不能反悔。

ex.en: Our car was turned back at the border.
ex.cn: 我们的汽车在边境被挡了回来。

ex.en: I waited a long time for him to return.
ex.cn: 我等他回来等了很长时间。

ex.en: Come back and visit again soon!
ex.cn: 请早点儿再回来探访！

ex.en: Do you ever want to go back to China?
ex.cn: 你想过回中国去吗？

senses.def: to reject or refuse to consider an offer, a proposal, etc. or the person who makes it
senses.chn: 拒绝，顶回（提议、建议或提议人）

ex.en: Why did she turn down your invitation?
ex.cn: 她为什么谢绝你的邀请？

ex.en: He has been turned down for ten jobs so far.
ex.cn: 他迄今申请了十份工作都遭到拒绝。

ex.en: He asked her to marry him but she turned him down.
ex.cn: 他请求她嫁给他，但是她回绝了。

senses.def: to reduce the noise, heat, etc. produced by a piece of equipment by moving its controls

ex.en: Please turn the volume down.
ex.cn: 请把音量调低些。

ex.en: He turned the lights down low.
ex.cn: 他把灯光调得暗了一些。

senses.def: to face or curve towards the centre

ex.en: Her feet turn in.
ex.cn: 她的两脚呈内八字。

senses.def: to go to bed
to take sb to the police or sb in authority because they have committed a crime
senses.chn: 把…扭送（到警察局）；使自首

ex.en: She threatened to turn him in to the police.
ex.cn: 她扬言要把他交给警方。

ex.en: He decided to turn himself in.
ex.cn: 他决定到警察局去自首。

senses.def: to give back sth that you no longer need
senses.chn: 交还，退还（不再需要的东西）

ex.en: You must turn in your pass when you leave the building.
ex.cn: 你离开大楼时必须交还通行证。

senses.def: to give sth to sb in authority

ex.en: They turned in a petition with 80 000 signatures.
ex.cn: 他们递交了一份有 8 万人签名的请愿书。

ex.en: I haven't even turned in Monday's work yet.
ex.cn: 我连星期一的作业还没交呢。

senses.def: to achieve a score, performance, profit, etc.
senses.chn: 取得（分数）；完成（表演）；获得（利润）

ex.en: The champion turned in a superb performance to retain her title.
ex.cn: 上届冠军表现十分出色，卫冕成功。

senses.def: to become too concerned with your own problems and stop communicating with others
senses.chn: 忙于自己的事情而不与人交往；闭门谢客

senses.def: to become sth

ex.en: Our dream holiday turned into a nightmare.
ex.cn: 我们梦想的假日变成了一场噩梦。

ex.en: In one year she turned from a problem child into a model student.
ex.cn: 一年内，她从问题儿童变成了模范学生。

senses.def: to make sb/sth become sth

ex.en: Ten years of prison had turned him into an old man.
ex.cn: 十年大狱使他变成了一个老头。

ex.en: The prince was turned into a frog by the witch.
ex.cn: 王子被女巫变成了一只青蛙。

senses.def: to leave a road in order to travel on another

ex.en: Is this where we turn off?
ex.cn: 这儿是我们换道的地方吗？

ex.en: The jet began to turn off the main runway.
ex.cn: 那架喷气式飞机开始拐出主跑道。

senses.def: to stop listening to or thinking about sb/sth

ex.en: I couldn't understand the lecture so I just turned off.
ex.cn: 我听不懂讲课，所以也就不听了。

senses.def: to make sb feel bored or not interested

ex.en: People had been turned off by both candidates in the election.
ex.cn: 大选中的两位候选人都让人觉得扫兴。

senses.def: to stop sb feeling sexually attracted; to make sb have a feeling of disgust
senses.chn: 使（异性）失去兴趣；使厌恶

senses.def: to stop the flow of electricity, gas, water, etc. by moving a switch, button, etc.
senses.chn: 关掉，截断（电流、煤气、水等）

ex.en: to turn off the light
ex.cn: 关上灯

ex.en: Please turn the television off before you go to bed.
ex.cn: 睡觉前请关上电视。

senses.def: to attack sb suddenly and unexpectedly

ex.en: The dogs suddenly turned on each other.
ex.cn: 那两条狗突然互相撕咬了起来。

ex.en: Why are you all turning on me (= criticizing or blaming me)?
ex.cn: 你们怎么突然都冲我来了？

senses.def: to depend on sth

ex.en: Much turns on the outcome of the current peace talks.
ex.cn: 事情主要取决于当前和谈的结果。

senses.def: to have sth as its main topic

ex.en: The discussion turned on the need to raise standards.
ex.cn: 这次讨论的主要议题是提高标准的必要性。

senses.def: to make sb excited or interested, especially sexually

ex.en: Jazz has never really turned me on.
ex.cn: 我对爵士乐从未真正产生过兴趣。

ex.en: She gets turned on by men in uniform.
ex.cn: 她看到穿制服的男人就欲火攻心。

senses.def: to make sb become interested in sth or to use sth for the first time
senses.chn: 使对…感兴趣；使首次使用

ex.en: He turned her on to jazz.
ex.cn: 他使她对爵士乐产生了兴趣。

senses.def: to start the flow of electricity, gas, water, etc. by moving a switch, button, etc.
senses.chn: 接通（电流、煤气、水等）；打开

ex.en: to turn on the heating
ex.cn: 打开供热系统

ex.en: I'll turn the television on.
ex.cn: 我来打开电视机。

ex.en: He really knows how to turn on the charm (= suddenly become pleasant and attractive).
ex.cn: 他确实懂得如何一展魅力。

senses.def: to be present at an event

ex.en: A vast crowd turned out to watch the procession.
ex.cn: 有一大群人出来观看游行队伍。

senses.def: to happen in a particular way; to develop or end in a particular way

ex.en: Despite our worries everything turned out well.
ex.cn: 尽管我们都很担心，结果一切都顺利。

ex.en: You never know how your children will turn out.
ex.cn: 很难说子女将来的发展怎样。

ex.en: If the day turns out wet, we may have to change our plans.
ex.cn: 如果那天下雨的话，我们可能得改变计划。

senses.def: to point away from the centre

ex.en: Her toes turn out.
ex.cn: 她的脚趾向外撇。

senses.def: to be discovered to be; to prove to be

ex.en: It turned out that she was a friend of my sister.
ex.cn: 她原来是我姐姐的朋友。

ex.en: The job turned out to be harder than we thought.
ex.cn: 这工作结果比我们想象的要难。

ex.en: The house they had offered us turned out to be a tiny apartment.
ex.cn: 他们向我们提供的房子原来是很小的公寓套间。

senses.def: to produce sb/sth

ex.en: The factory turns out 900 cars a week.
ex.cn: 这家工厂每周生产 900 辆汽车。

senses.def: to force sb to leave a place
to switch a light or a source of heat off

ex.en: Remember to turn out the lights when you go to bed.
ex.cn: 临睡前别忘了关灯。

senses.def: to clean sth thoroughly by removing the contents and organizing them again

ex.en: to turn out the attic
ex.cn: 把阁楼腾空清扫

senses.def: to empty sth, especially your pockets
to make sth point away from the centre

ex.en: She turned her toes out.
ex.cn: 她把脚趾向外撇。

senses.def: to change position so that the other side is facing towards the outside or the top

ex.en: If you turn over you might find it easier to get to sleep.
ex.cn: 你若翻个身，也许入睡容易些。

ex.en: The car skidded and turned over.
ex.cn: 汽车打滑向一侧翻倒了。

ex.en: The smell made my stomach turn over (= made me feel sick).
ex.cn: 这气味让我反胃。

senses.def: to start or to continue to run
to change to another channel when you are watching television
to do business worth a particular amount of money in a particular period of time
senses.chn: 营业额为…；做金额为…的生意

ex.en: The company turns over £3.5 million a year.
ex.cn: 这家公司一年的营业额为 350 万英镑。

senses.def: to make sth change position so that the other side is facing towards the outside or the top

ex.en: Brown the meat on one side, then turn it over and brown the other side.
ex.cn: 把肉的一面烤黄，然后翻转过来，再烤另一面。

senses.def: to think about sth carefully

ex.en: She kept turning over the events of the day in her mind.
ex.cn: 她脑子里不断琢磨当天发生的事。

senses.def: to sell goods and replace them

ex.en: A supermarket will turn over its stock very rapidly.
ex.cn: 超市的货物周转得很快。

senses.def: to steal from a place

ex.en: Burglars had turned the house over.
ex.cn: 盗贼把这所房子盗窃一空。

senses.def: to make an engine start running
to deliver sb to the control or care of sb else, especially sb in authority
senses.chn: 移交，送交（他人看管，尤指当局）

ex.en: Customs officials turned the man over to the police.
ex.cn: 海关官员把那个男子移交给警方看管。

senses.def: to give the control of sth to sb

ex.en: He turned the business over to his daughter.
ex.cn: 他把这个企业交给了女儿管理。

senses.def: to change the use or function of sth

ex.en: The factory was turned over to the manufacture of aircraft parts.
ex.cn: 这家工厂转产飞机部件。

senses.def: to go to sb/sth for help, advice, etc.

ex.en: She has nobody she can turn to.
ex.cn: 她求助无门。

senses.def: to be found, especially by chance, after being lost
senses.chn: （尤指失去后偶然）被发现，被找到

ex.en: Don't worry about the letter—I'm sure it'll turn up.
ex.cn: 别为那封信担心，我相信会找到的。

senses.def: to arrive

ex.en: We arranged to meet at 7.30, but she never turned up.
ex.cn: 我们约好 7:30 碰头，但她根本没露面。

senses.def: to happen, especially by chance

ex.en: He's still hoping something (= for example, a job or a piece of luck) will turn up.
ex.cn: 他仍然在希望会有机会出现。

senses.def: to increase the sound, heat, etc. of a piece of equipment

ex.en: Could you turn the TV up?
ex.cn: 你能把电视机的音量开大些吗？

ex.en: The music was turned up loud.
ex.cn: 音乐的音量开大了。

senses.def: to make a piece of clothing shorter by folding and sewing it up at the bottom
senses.chn: 将（衣服的底边）折起缝好；改短

senses.def: to find sth

ex.en: Our efforts to trace him turned up nothing.
ex.cn: 我们辛辛苦苦跟踪他，却无功而返。

senses.def: an act of turning sb/sth around

ex.en: Give the handle a few turns.
ex.cn: 转动几下把手。

senses.def: a change in direction in a vehicle

ex.en: Make a left/right turn into West Street.
ex.cn: 向左／右拐入西大街。

senses.def: a place where a road leads away from the one you are travelling on
a bend or corner in a road

ex.en: a lane full of twists and turns
ex.cn: 弯弯曲曲的小巷

senses.def: the time when sb in a group of people should or is allowed to do sth

ex.en: When it's your turn, take another card.
ex.cn: 轮到你时，再抓一张牌。

ex.en: Please wait your turn.
ex.cn: 请等着轮到你。

ex.en: Whose turn is it to cook?
ex.cn: 轮到谁做饭了？

ex.en: Steve took a turn driving while I slept.
ex.cn: 我睡觉时，史蒂夫接着开车。

senses.def: an unusual or unexpected change in what is happening
senses.chn: （异乎寻常或意外的）变化，转变

ex.en: a surprising turn of events
ex.cn: 意想不到的事态变化

ex.en: His health has taken a turn for the worse (= suddenly got worse).
ex.cn: 他的健康状况突然恶化。

ex.en: Events took a dramatic turn in the weeks that followed.
ex.cn: 在以后的几周里，事态急转直下。

ex.en: The book is, by turns, funny and very sad.
ex.cn: 这部书时而妙趣横生，时而悲悲戚戚。

senses.def: a short performance or piece of entertainment such as a song, etc.

ex.en: Everyone got up on stage to do a turn.
ex.cn: 每个人都登台表演了一个小节目。

senses.def: a short walk

ex.en: We took a turn around the park.
ex.cn: 我们在公园里转了一圈。

senses.def: a feeling of illness

ex.en: a funny turn (= a feeling that you may faint)
ex.cn: 感到一阵晕眩

senses.def: everywhere or every time you try and do sth

ex.en: At every turn I met with disappointment.
ex.cn: 我事事都不顺心。

senses.def: (to do) sth that helps sb
senses.chn: （为某人做）好事，善事；（做）有助于某人的事

ex.en: Well, that's my good turn for the day.
ex.cn: 好啦，这就是我今天做的好事。

senses.def: cooked for exactly the right amount of time
to frighten or shock sb
senses.chn: 使大吃一惊；吓某人一跳

senses.def: one after the other in a particular order

ex.en: The children called out their names in turn.
ex.cn: 孩子们逐一自报姓名。

senses.def: as a result of sth in a series of events

ex.en: Increased production will, in turn, lead to increased profits.
ex.cn: 增加生产会继而增加利润。

senses.def: you should help sb who has helped you
senses.chn: 善须善报；要以德报德；好人应得好报

senses.def: going to change soon

ex.en: His luck is on the turn.
ex.cn: 他就要时来运转了。

senses.def: to say sth that you should not because it is the wrong situation or because it offends sb
senses.chn: 说话出格（或冒失、鲁莽、不合时宜）

senses.def: if people take turns or take it in turns to do sth, they do it one after the other to make sure it is done fairly

ex.en: The male and female birds take turns in sitting on the eggs.
ex.cn: 雄鸟和雌鸟轮流伏窝。

ex.en: We take it in turns to do the housework.
ex.cn: 我们轮流做家务。

senses.def: the time when a new century/year starts
senses.chn: 世纪之交；新年伊始；辞旧迎新之际

ex.en: It was built at the turn of the century.
ex.cn: 这是在世纪之交修建的。

senses.def: a particular way of thinking about things
a particular way of describing sth
senses.chn: 措辞；表达方式；描述方式

senses.def: an extra amount of pressure, cruelty, etc. added to a situation that is already difficult to bear or understand
a sudden increase in your speed or rate of progress; the ability to suddenly increase your speed
senses.chn: 突然加速；加快进度；突然加快的能力

ex.en: He put on an impressive turn of speed in the last lap.
ex.cn: 他在最后一圈猛然加速。

senses.def: to do no work

ex.en: She hasn't done a hand's turn all week.
ex.cn: 她闲了整整一星期。

senses.def: to be useful for a particular purpose or period of time
senses.chn: （在某方面或某期间）发挥作用，派上用场；足以满足…的需要

example.en: He turned the key in the lock.
example.cn: 他转动钥匙开锁。

example.en: He turned back to his work.
example.cn: 他回去继续工作。

example.en: He turned into a narrow street.
example.cn: 他拐进了一条狭窄的街道。

example.en: The man turned the corner and disappeared.
example.cn: 那男人转过街角就没影了。

example.en: I turned the car into the car park.
example.cn: 我转弯把汽车开进了停车场。

example.en: Police turned water cannon on the rioters.
example.cn: 警察把高压水枪对准了闹事者。

example.en: His thoughts turned to his dead wife.
example.cn: 他想起了自己已故的妻子。

example.en: to turn the dogs loose
example.cn: 把狗放开

example.en: Turn to p.23.
example.cn: 翻到第 23 页。

example.en: The leaves were turning brown.
example.cn: 叶子变黄。

example.en: She turned a deathly shade of white when she heard the news.
example.cn: 她听到这个消息时面如死灰。

example.en: It turned out that she was a friend of my sister.
example.cn: 她原来是我姐姐的朋友。

example.en: The job turned out to be harder than we thought.
example.cn: 这工作结果比我们想象的要难。

senses.def: a sudden and complete change in sb/sth
senses.chn: 突变；一百八十度的大转弯；变卦

senses.def: to stop or make sb stop being friendly towards sb

ex.en: She turned against her old friend.
ex.cn: 她与老朋友翻脸了。

ex.en: After the divorce he tried to turn the children against their mother.
ex.cn: 他离婚后企图教唆子女反对他们的母亲。

senses.def: the amount of time it takes to unload a ship or plane at the end of one journey and load it again for the next one
the amount of time it takes to do a piece of work that you have been given and return it
senses.chn: （接活到交活之间的）周转期，时限

senses.def: a situation in which sth changes from bad to good

ex.en: a turnaround in the economy
ex.cn: 经济好转

senses.def: a complete change in sb's opinion, behaviour, etc.
to have sex with sb for money
to return the way you have come; to make sb/sth do this

ex.en: The weather became so bad that they had to turn back.
ex.cn: 天气变得非常恶劣，他们不得不循原路折回。

ex.en: We said we would do it—there can be no turning back.
ex.cn: 我们说过要干这事，不能反悔。

ex.en: Our car was turned back at the border.
ex.cn: 我们的汽车在边境被挡了回来。

ex.en: I waited a long time for him to return.
ex.cn: 我等他回来等了很长时间。
